en: Family or career: a reader poll
Review of A2: comparison, commands, the conditional, aspect and the future
Should: mal by som, mala by si
Quantities: veľa, málo, viac, menej + the genitive plural
t: A2 takrori: qiyosiy daraja, buyruq, shart mayli, feʼl turi va kelasi zamon
«…ish kerak»: mal by som, mala by si
Aylanmoq, boʻlib qolmoq: stať sa + inštrumentál
Miqdor: veľa, málo, viac, menej + koʻplikdagi genitív

a2-u10-l1.studentsky-casopis.note.en: You know **časopis** from A1. This autumn Lucia starts writing for the university's magazine: Lucia píše **pre študentský časopis**.
a2-u10-l1.studentsky-casopis.note.t: **časopis** soʻzini A1 dan bilasiz. Bu kuzda Lusiya universitet jurnaliga yoza boshlaydi: Lucia píše **pre študentský časopis**. = Lusiya talabalar jurnaliga yozadi.

a2-u10-l1.redakcia.note.en: The people who make a paper or a magazine, and the room they work in: Lucia ide **do redakcie**. Je **v redakcii**.
a2-u10-l1.redakcia.note.t: Gazeta yoki jurnalni tayyorlaydigan odamlar ham, ular ishlaydigan xona ham: Lucia ide **do redakcie**. = Lusiya tahririyatga ketyapti. Je **v redakcii**. = U tahririyatda.

en: Lucia is going to the editorial office.
Lucia writes for the student magazine.

a2-u10-l1.stala-som-sa-redaktorkou.en.en: I've become an editor. (a woman speaking)

a2-u10-l1.stala-som-sa-redaktorkou.note.en: A **redaktor** or **redaktorka** writes and edits for a paper or a magazine. **Stať sa** (to become) takes the instrumental, as in A1: stať sa lekárom.
a2-u10-l1.stala-som-sa-redaktorkou.note.t: **redaktor** yoki **redaktorka** — gazeta yoki jurnal uchun yozadigan va tahrir qiladigan kishi, muharrir. **Stať sa** (boʻlmoq) inštrumentál («bilan» kelishigi) talab qiladi, A1 dagidek: stať sa lekárom (shifokor boʻlmoq).

a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-sa-stala.en.en: Lucia has become an editor at the student magazine.

a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-sa-stala.why.en: **Stať sa** (to become) takes the instrumental, and feminine -a changes to **-ou**: stala sa **redaktorkou**.
a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-sa-stala.why.t: **Stať sa** (boʻlmoq) inštrumentál talab qiladi, shuning uchun ayol jinsidagi soʻzda -a oʻrniga **-ou** keladi: stala sa **redaktorkou**.

a2-u10-l1.horoskop.note.en: Lucia will write the magazine's **horoskop**: what the stars say about your week.
a2-u10-l1.horoskop.note.t: Lusiya jurnal uchun **horoskop** yozadi: yulduzlar haftangiz haqida nima deyishini.

a2-u10-l1.anketa.note.en: In an **anketa** the magazine asks its readers a question, and they **odpovedajú** (answer). A reader is a **čitateľ** or a **čitateľka**; plural **čitatelia**, like učitelia.
a2-u10-l1.anketa.note.t: **anketa** — soʻrovnoma: jurnal oʻquvchilariga savol beradi, ular esa **odpovedajú** (javob berishadi). Oʻquvchi — **čitateľ** yoki **čitateľka**; koʻplikda **čitatelia**, učitelia kabi.

a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-pise-clanok.en.en: Lucia is writing an article for the student magazine.
a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-pise-clanok.en.t: Lusiya talabalar jurnali uchun maqola yozyapti.

a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-pise-clanok.why.en: Časopis is masculine, and after **pre** comes the object form, where masculine things don't change: pre **študentský** časopis.
a2-u10-l1.fill-lucia-pise-clanok.why.t: Časopis erkak jinsida, **pre** (uchun) dan keyin esa toʻldiruvchi shakli keladi, unda erkak jinsidagi narsalar oʻzgarmaydi: pre **študentský** časopis.

a2-u10-l1.vychadzat.note.en: Náš časopis **vychádza** raz za mesiac. = Our magazine comes out once a month. One that comes out **každý týždeň** (every week) is a **týždenník**.
a2-u10-l1.vychadzat.note.t: Náš časopis **vychádza** raz za mesiac. = Jurnalimiz oyda bir marta chiqadi. **každý týždeň** (har hafta) chiqadigani — **týždenník** (haftalik).

a2-u10-l1.build-casopis-vychadza-raz.pro.en: The magazine comes out once a month.

en: Časopis is one thing (on), so the verb has no ending: **vychádza**. Vychádzajú is for oni.
A month is **mesiac**. Týždeň is a week: raz za týždeň.
t: Časopis — bitta narsa (on), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **vychádza**. Vychádzajú — oni (ular) uchun.
Oy — **mesiac**. Týždeň — hafta: raz za týždeň (haftada bir marta).

a2-u10-l1.fill-casopis-ktory-vychadza.en.en: A magazine that comes out every week is a weekly.

a2-u10-l1.fill-casopis-ktory-vychadza.wh.en: **Týždenník** is made from týždeň (week): a paper or magazine that comes out every week.
a2-u10-l1.fill-casopis-ktory-vychadza.wh.t: **Týždenník** soʻzi týždeň (hafta) dan yasalgan: har hafta chiqadigan gazeta yoki jurnal.

a2-u10-l1.nove-cislo.note.en: **číslo** is a number, and also one issue of a magazine: V novom čísle je Luciin prvý článok.
a2-u10-l1.nove-cislo.note.t: **číslo** — raqam, son; xuddi oʻzbekchadagi «son» kabi, jurnalning bitta soni ham: V novom čísle je Luciin prvý článok. = Yangi sonda Lusiyaning birinchi maqolasi chiqdi.

a2-u10-l1.fill-v-novom-cisle.en.en: Lucia's first article is in the new issue.

a2-u10-l1.fill-v-novom-cisle.why.en: **V** answering “where?” takes the locative, and neuter -o changes to **-e**: v novom **čísle**, like v meste.
a2-u10-l1.fill-v-novom-cisle.why.t: **V** «qayerda?» savoliga javob berganda lokál (oʻrin-payt kelishigi) talab qiladi, oʻrta jinsdagi -o esa **-e** ga aylanadi: v novom **čísle**, v meste kabi.

a2-u10-l1.choice-ako-casto-vychadza.ques.en: Emma wants to know how often Lucia's magazine comes out. What does she ask?
a2-u10-l1.choice-ako-casto-vychadza.ques.t: Emma Lusiyaning jurnali qanchalik tez-tez chiqishini bilmoqchi. U nima deb soʻraydi?

a2-u10-l1.build-v-novom-cisle.prompt.en: In the new issue there's a poll and a horoscope.
a2-u10-l1.build-v-novom-cisle.prompt.t: Yangi sonda soʻrovnoma va goroskop bor.

en: In the new issue answers “where?”, so the adjective takes the locative too: **v novom** čísle.
The poll is the subject here (there is a poll), so it stays in its basic form: **anketa**. Ankety is the plural.
t: «Yangi sonda» — «qayerda?» savoliga javob, shuning uchun sifat ham lokálda keladi: **v novom** čísle.
Bu yerda soʻrovnoma — gapning egasi (soʻrovnoma bor), shuning uchun asosiy shaklda qoladi: **anketa**. Ankety — koʻplik.

a2-u10-l1.choice-o-com-pises.question.en: Emma asks Lucia what she's writing about. What does she say?
a2-u10-l1.choice-o-com-pises.question.t: Emma Lusiyadan nima haqida yozayotganini soʻramoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l1.choice-o-com-pises.why.en: Emma and Lucia are friends, so Emma uses **ty**, and the verb ends in **-š**: píše**š**. Píšete is for vy, píše for on or ona.
a2-u10-l1.choice-o-com-pises.why.t: Emma va Lusiya — dugonalar, shuning uchun Emma **ty** (sen) ishlatadi, feʼl esa **-š** bilan tugaydi: píše**š**. Píšete — vy (siz) uchun, píše — on yoki ona uchun.

a2-u10-l1.speak-pisem-pre-studentsky.en.en: I write for the student magazine.

a2-u10-l2.zmenit-sa.note.en: **Mesto sa zmenilo.** = The town has changed. Zmeniť sa is perfective: one finished change. Its imperfective partner **meniť sa** is change that goes on: Mesto sa **stále** (all the time) mení.
a2-u10-l2.zmenit-sa.note.t: **Mesto sa zmenilo.** = Shahar oʻzgardi. Zmeniť sa — tugallangan tur: bir martalik, oxiriga yetgan oʻzgarish. Uning tugallanmagan jufti **meniť sa** davom etayotgan oʻzgarish uchun: Mesto sa **stále** (doim) mení. = Shahar doim oʻzgarib turadi.

a2-u10-l2.kedysi-tu-bolo.en.en: There used to be fewer cars here.
a2-u10-l2.kedysi-tu-bolo.en.t: Ilgari bu yerda mashinalar kamroq edi.

a2-u10-l2.kedysi-tu-bolo.note.en: **kedysi** = once, in the old days; **v deväťdesiatych rokoch** = in the nineties. **menej** (fewer) and **viac** (more) are followed by the genitive plural, as veľa is: menej **áut**, viac **ľudí**.
a2-u10-l2.kedysi-tu-bolo.note.t: **kedysi** = ilgari, bir paytlar; **v deväťdesiatych rokoch** = toʻqsoninchi yillarda. **menej** (kamroq) va **viac** (koʻproq) dan keyin, veľa dan keyingidek, ot koʻplikdagi genitívda (qaratqich kelishigi) keladi: menej **áut**, viac **ľudí**.

a2-u10-l2.choice-bratislava-sa-velmi.que.en: For her first article, Lucia asks pán Kováč about the city. What does he mean?
a2-u10-l2.choice-bratislava-sa-velmi.que.t: Birinchi maqolasi uchun Lusiya janob Kovachdan shahar haqida soʻrayapti. U nima demoqchi?

en: Bratislava is changing all the time.

a2-u10-l2.choice-bratislava-sa-velmi.why.en: **Zmenila sa** is the past of zmeniť sa, one finished change: it has changed. Changing all the time would be **stále sa mení**.
a2-u10-l2.choice-bratislava-sa-velmi.why.t: **Zmenila sa** — zmeniť sa ning oʻtgan zamoni, bir martalik tugallangan oʻzgarish: oʻzgardi. «Doim oʻzgarib turadi» — **stále sa mení**.

a2-u10-l2.fill-dnes-je-v.en.en: Today there are more cars in town.

a2-u10-l2.fill-dnes-je-v.why.en: After **viac** (more) the noun takes the genitive plural. For auto that's **áut**: the ending goes and the vowel gets longer.
a2-u10-l2.fill-dnes-je-v.why.t: **viac** (koʻproq) dan keyin ot koʻplikdagi genitívda keladi. Auto uchun bu **áut**: qoʻshimcha tushib qoladi, unli esa choʻziladi.

a2-u10-l2.budova.note.en: Plural **budovy**. Pri rieke sú nové budovy: kancelárie, byty a obchody. The middle of a town is its **centrum** (v centre); a big building full of shops is a **nákupné centrum**.
a2-u10-l2.budova.note.t: Koʻplikda **budovy**. Pri rieke sú nové budovy: kancelárie, byty a obchody. = Daryo boʻyida yangi binolar bor: ofislar, kvartiralar va doʻkonlar. Shaharning markazi — **centrum** (v centre = markazda); doʻkonlarga toʻla katta bino — **nákupné centrum** (savdo markazi).

a2-u10-l2.vacsi-mensi.note.en: You know them from unit 3, with ako (than): Bratislava je menšia ako Viedeň.
a2-u10-l2.vacsi-mensi.note.t: Ularni 3-boʻlimdan bilasiz, ako («…dan») bilan: Bratislava je menšia ako Viedeň. = Bratislava Venadan kichikroq.

a2-u10-l2.fill-bratislava-je-mensia.why.en: Bratislava is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: menš**ia**. Menší goes with masculine words, menšie with neuter words and plurals.
a2-u10-l2.fill-bratislava-je-mensia.why.t: Bratislava ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: menš**ia**. Menší erkak jinsidagi soʻzlar bilan, menšie esa oʻrta jinsdagi soʻzlar va koʻplik bilan keladi.

a2-u10-l2.cena.question.en: You met cena in unit 1: a prize, and also a price. What does this mean?
a2-u10-l2.cena.question.t: cena soʻzini 1-boʻlimda uchratgansiz: mukofot, shuningdek narx. Bu nimani anglatadi?

en: Prizes are bigger than they used to be.
Prices are lower than they used to be.
Prices are higher than they used to be.

a2-u10-l2.build-byty-su-drahsie.prompt.en: Flats are more expensive than they used to be.

en: Byty is plural (things), so the comparative ends in **-ie**: byty sú **drahšie**, like drahé.
More expensive is **drahšie**, from drahý. Lacnejšie (cheaper) comes from lacný.
t: Byty — koʻplik (narsalar), shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ie** bilan tugaydi: byty sú **drahšie**, drahé kabi.
Qimmatroq — **drahšie**, drahý (qimmat) dan. Lacnejšie (arzonroq) esa lacný (arzon) dan.

a2-u10-l2.najvacsia-zmena.note.en: **zmena** = a change. With naj-, as in unit 3: najväčší, najdrahší (the most expensive).
a2-u10-l2.najvacsia-zmena.note.t: **zmena** = oʻzgarish. naj- bilan, 3-boʻlimdagidek, oʻzbekchadagi «eng» kabi: najväčší (eng katta), najdrahší (eng qimmat).

a2-u10-l2.choice-najdrahsie-byty.questio.en: Which one means “the most expensive flats”?

a2-u10-l2.choice-najdrahsie-byty.why.en: The superlative is **naj-** + the comparative: **naj**drahšie. Byty is plural, so it ends in -ie; najdrahší goes with one masculine thing.
a2-u10-l2.choice-najdrahsie-byty.why.t: Orttirma daraja — **naj-** + qiyosiy daraja, soʻzga qoʻshib yoziladi: **naj**drahšie. Byty koʻplikda, shuning uchun -ie bilan tugaydi; najdrahší bitta erkak jinsidagi narsa bilan keladi.

a2-u10-l2.doprava.note.en: In A1, doprava was “to the right”. It's also the traffic: **Doprava je horšia** ako kedysi. (horší = worse, from zlý)
a2-u10-l2.doprava.note.t: A1 da doprava «oʻngga» degani edi. U yoʻl harakatini ham bildiradi: **Doprava je horšia** ako kedysi. = Yoʻl harakati avvalgidan yomonroq. (horší = yomonroq, zlý dan)

a2-u10-l2.fill-doprava-je-horsia.en.en: There are a lot of cars in the centre, and the traffic is worse than it used to be.
a2-u10-l2.fill-doprava-je-horsia.en.t: Markazda mashinalar koʻp, yoʻl harakati esa avvalgidan yomonroq.

a2-u10-l2.fill-doprava-je-horsia.why.en: Doprava is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: horš**ia**.
a2-u10-l2.fill-doprava-je-horsia.why.t: Doprava ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: horš**ia**.

a2-u10-l2.fill-pan-kovac-hovori.en.en: Pán Kováč says there didn't use to be a shopping centre here.
a2-u10-l2.fill-pan-kovac-hovori.en.t: Janob Kovachning aytishicha, ilgari bu yerda savdo markazi boʻlmagan.

a2-u10-l2.fill-pan-kovac-hovori.why.en: Centrum is neuter, so the past form of byť ends in **-lo**: nebolo, with ne- for “not”.
a2-u10-l2.fill-pan-kovac-hovori.why.t: Centrum oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun byť ning oʻtgan zamon shakli **-lo** bilan tugaydi: nebolo, ne- esa inkorni bildiradi.

en: In the nineties there were fewer cars here.
There were fewer cars here in the nineties.
t: Toʻqsoninchi yillarda bu yerda mashinalar kamroq edi.
Bu yerda toʻqsoninchi yillarda mashinalar kamroq edi.
Toʻqsoninchi yillarda bu yerda mashina kamroq edi.

en: Bratislava is feminine, so the past form ends in **-la**: zmenila sa.
To change, to become different, is **zmeniť sa**, with sa, and sa takes second place: Ako **sa**…
t: Bratislava ayol jinsida, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: zmenila sa.
Oʻzgarmoq, boshqacha boʻlib qolmoq — **zmeniť sa**, sa bilan, sa esa ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Ako **sa**…

a2-u10-l2.speak-mesto-sa-velmi.en.en: The town has changed a lot.

a2-u10-l3.titleEn.en: Is this your first time here?

a2-u10-l3.mate-chvilku.note.en: A polite way to stop someone in the street: **Prepáčte, máte chvíľku?** To a friend: Máš chvíľku?
a2-u10-l3.mate-chvilku.note.t: Koʻchada birovni toʻxtatishning xushmuomala usuli: **Prepáčte, máte chvíľku?** = Kechirasiz, bir daqiqa vaqtingiz bormi? Doʻstga: Máš chvíľku?

a2-u10-l3.turista.note.en: It ends in -a but it's masculine, like dôchodca. Plural **turisti**; after veľa: veľa **turistov**. Tourism is **turizmus**.
a2-u10-l3.turista.note.t: U -a bilan tugaydi, lekin erkak jinsida, dôchodca kabi. Koʻplikda **turisti**; veľa dan keyin: veľa **turistov**. Turizm — **turizmus**.

a2-u10-l3.choice-prepacte-mate-chvilku.q.en: Lucia wants to stop a tourist in the street for her article. What does she say?
a2-u10-l3.choice-prepacte-mate-chvilku.q.t: Lusiya maqolasi uchun koʻchada bir sayyohni toʻxtatmoqchi. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l3.choice-prepacte-mate-chvilku.w.en: A stranger gets **vy**: prepáč**te**, máte. Prepáč, Ahoj and máš are for friends.
a2-u10-l3.choice-prepacte-mate-chvilku.w.t: Notanish odamga **vy** (siz) deyiladi: prepáč**te**, máte. Prepáč, Ahoj va máš — doʻstlar uchun.

a2-u10-l3.ste-tu-prvykrat.en.en: Is this your first time here?

a2-u10-l3.ste-tu-prvykrat.note.en: **prvýkrát** = for the first time. To a friend: **Si** tu prvýkrát?

a2-u10-l3.preco-ste-prisli.en.en: Why did you come here, of all places?

a2-u10-l3.preco-ste-prisli.note.en: **sem** = (to) here. **práve** puts weight on the next word: práve sem, práve do Bratislavy.
a2-u10-l3.preco-ste-prisli.note.t: **sem** = bu yerga. **práve** keyingi soʻzga urgʻu beradi, oʻzbekchadagi «aynan» kabi: práve sem, práve do Bratislavy.

a2-u10-l3.build-preco-ste-prisli.prompt.en: Why did you come to Bratislava? (to a tourist)

en: With polite **vy** the past form always ends in -li, even for one person: prišli ste.
**Do** (to) takes the genitive, -a becomes -y: do **Bratislavy**, like do kina, do práce. Bratislave is the “where” form.
t: Hurmatli **vy** bilan oʻtgan zamon shakli doim -li bilan tugaydi, bitta kishiga ham: prišli ste.
**Do** («…ga») genitív (qaratqich kelishigi) talab qiladi, -a esa -y ga aylanadi: do **Bratislavy**, do kina, do práce kabi. Bratislave — «qayerda?» shakli.

a2-u10-l3.co-sa-vam-najviac.note.en: **najviac** = most: veľa, viac, najviac. Najviac sa mi páči hrad. = I like the castle best.
a2-u10-l3.co-sa-vam-najviac.note.t: **najviac** = eng koʻp: veľa (koʻp), viac (koʻproq), najviac (eng koʻp). Najviac sa mi páči hrad. = Menga eng koʻp qalʼa yoqadi.

a2-u10-l3.fill-najviac-sa-mi.en.en: I like the old streets best.
a2-u10-l3.fill-najviac-sa-mi.en.t: Menga eng koʻp eski koʻchalar yoqadi.

a2-u10-l3.fill-najviac-sa-mi.why.en: Páčiť sa takes **mi** (to me): the streets please me. Ma is the object form, as in Bolí ma hlava.
a2-u10-l3.fill-najviac-sa-mi.why.t: Páčiť sa **mi** (menga) bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagi kabi: koʻchalar menga yoqadi. Ma — toʻldiruvchi shakli («meni»), Bolí ma hlava dagi kabi.

a2-u10-l3.pamiatka.note.en: **kultúrne pamiatky** are the sights: hrad, kostoly, múzeá, **galérie** (galleries). For fun (**zábava**), people go to **bary a kluby**.
a2-u10-l3.pamiatka.note.t: **kultúrne pamiatky** — diqqatga sazovor joylar: hrad (qalʼa), kostoly (cherkovlar), múzeá (muzeylar), **galérie** (galereyalar). Koʻngil ochish (**zábava**) uchun odamlar **bary a kluby** (barlar va klublar)ga boradi.

a2-u10-l3.fill-v-bratislave-je.en.en: There are a lot of cultural sights in Bratislava.

a2-u10-l3.fill-v-bratislave-je.why.en: After **veľa** comes the genitive plural. Feminine words in -ka drop the -a and add -o-: pamiatka → **pamiatok**.
a2-u10-l3.fill-v-bratislave-je.why.t: **veľa** dan keyin koʻplikdagi genitív keladi. -ka bilan tugaydigan ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar -a ni tashlab, -o- qoʻshadi: pamiatka → **pamiatok**.

a2-u10-l3.vacsina.note.en: **Väčšina turistov je z Rakúska a z Nemecka.** = Most of the tourists are from Austria and Germany. The verb is singular: väčšina **je**.
a2-u10-l3.vacsina.note.t: **Väčšina turistov je z Rakúska a z Nemecka.** = Sayyohlarning koʻpchiligi Avstriya va Germaniyadan. Feʼl birlikda keladi: väčšina **je**.

a2-u10-l3.choice-odkial-su-turisti.quest.en: Lucia asks a guide: Odkiaľ sú turisti v Bratislave? Which answer fits?
a2-u10-l3.choice-odkial-su-turisti.quest.t: Lusiya giddan soʻrayapti: Odkiaľ sú turisti v Bratislave? Qaysi javob mos keladi?

a2-u10-l3.choice-odkial-su-turisti.why.en: Odkiaľ? asks where from, so the answer takes **z** (from): z Nemecka, like z Írska. V Nemecku is where, do Nemecka where to.
a2-u10-l3.choice-odkial-su-turisti.why.t: Odkiaľ? «qayerdan?» deb soʻraydi, shuning uchun javobda **z** («…dan») keladi: z Nemecka, z Írska kabi. V Nemecku — «qayerda?», do Nemecka — «qayerga?».

a2-u10-l3.rovnaky-ako-iny.note.en: Ceny sú tu **rovnaké ako** v Prahe. = Prices here are the same as in Prague. Bratislava je **iná ako** Viedeň. **ten istý** = the very same: Máme ten istý mobil.
a2-u10-l3.rovnaky-ako-iny.note.t: Ceny sú tu **rovnaké ako** v Prahe. = Bu yerda narxlar Pragadagi bilan bir xil. Bratislava je **iná ako** Viedeň. = Bratislava Venadan farq qiladi. **ten istý** = aynan oʻsha: Máme ten istý mobil. = Telefonlarimiz bir xil.

a2-u10-l3.fill-ceny-su-tu.en.en: Prices here are the same as in Prague.
a2-u10-l3.fill-ceny-su-tu.en.t: Bu yerda narxlar Pragadagi bilan bir xil.

a2-u10-l3.fill-ceny-su-tu.why.en: Ceny is plural (things), so the adjective ends in **-é**: rovnaké ako, like tie mosty sú nové.
a2-u10-l3.fill-ceny-su-tu.why.t: Ceny — koʻplik (narsalar), shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: rovnaké ako, tie mosty sú nové kabi.

en: Bratislava is different from Vienna, but I like it better.
Bratislava is different from Vienna, but I like it more.
t: Bratislava Venadan farq qiladi, lekin menga koʻproq yoqadi.
Bratislava Venadan boshqacha, lekin menga koʻproq yoqadi.
Bratislava Venaga oʻxshamaydi, lekin menga koʻproq yoqadi.

a2-u10-l3.build-co-sa-vam.prompt.en: What do you like best in Bratislava? (to a tourist)
a2-u10-l3.build-co-sa-vam.prompt.t: Bratislavada sizga eng koʻp nima yoqadi? (sayyohga)

en: A tourist is a stranger, so use vy: páči sa **vám**. Ti is for a friend.
In Bratislava answers “where?”, so it takes the locative: v **Bratislave**.
t: Sayyoh — notanish odam, shuning uchun vy: páči sa **vám** (sizga). Ti (senga) — doʻst uchun.
«Bratislavada» — «qayerda?» savoliga javob, shuning uchun lokál keladi: v **Bratislave**.

a2-u10-l3.speak-prepacte-mate-chvilku.en.en: Excuse me, have you got a moment?

a2-u10-l4.podnajom.note.en: **bývať v podnájme** = to live in a rented flat or room. Lucia is tired of the dorm: Chce bývať v podnájme, nie na internáte.
a2-u10-l4.podnajom.note.t: **bývať v podnájme** = ijarada yashamoq (kvartira yoki xonada). Lusiya yotoqxonadan charchadi: Chce bývať v podnájme, nie na internáte. = U yotoqxonada emas, ijarada yashamoqchi.

a2-u10-l4.byt-na-prenajom.note.en: Ads often say **Prenajmem byt.** (I'll let a flat.) To rent one for yourself is **prenajať si** byt.
a2-u10-l4.byt-na-prenajom.note.t: Eʼlonlarda koʻpincha **Prenajmem byt.** (Kvartirani ijaraga beraman.) deb yoziladi. Oʻzingiz uchun ijaraga olish — **prenajať si** byt.

a2-u10-l4.choice-lucia-chce-byvat.questi.en: Lucia says: Chcem bývať v podnájme. What does she want?
a2-u10-l4.choice-lucia-chce-byvat.questi.t: Lusiya aytyapti: Chcem bývať v podnájme. U nimani xohlaydi?

en: to live in a rented flat

a2-u10-l4.neviem-ci-tu.en.en: I don't know if I'll stay here.

a2-u10-l4.neviem-ci-tu.note.en: Lucia asks Emma to share a flat, but Emma's year is ending. **či** = whether, if: a yes/no question inside a sentence. **zostať** = to stay; like stretnúť, its present form points to the future: zostanem, zostaneš…
a2-u10-l4.neviem-ci-tu.note.t: Lusiya Emmaga birga kvartira olishni taklif qiladi, lekin Emmaning oʻqish yili tugayapti. **či** — gap ichidagi «ha/yoʻq» savoli, oʻzbekchadagi «qolamanmi, yoʻqmi» kabi. **zostať** = qolmoq; stretnúť kabi uning hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi: zostanem, zostaneš… (qolaman, qolasan…)

a2-u10-l4.build-emma-nevie-ci.prompt.en: Emma doesn't know if she'll stay in Bratislava.

en: A yes/no question inside a sentence takes **či** (whether): nevie, **či** zostane. Že (that) passes on a statement.
Emma is ona, so the verb has no ending: **zostane**. Zostanem is for ja.
t: Gap ichidagi «ha/yoʻq» savoli **či** («…mi») bilan keladi: nevie, **či** zostane. Že («…ki», «…ligini») darak gapni yetkazadi.
Emma — ona (u), shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **zostane**. Zostanem — ja (men) uchun.

a2-u10-l4.najomne.note.en: It looks like an adjective: nájomné **je** 500 eur **mesačne** (a month). **energie** are the bills for electricity, gas and heating; **energie v cene** = bills included.
a2-u10-l4.najomne.note.t: U sifatga oʻxshaydi: nájomné **je** 500 eur **mesačne** (oyiga). **energie** — elektr, gaz va isitish uchun toʻlovlar; **energie v cene** = kommunal toʻlovlar narxga kiritilgan.

a2-u10-l4.fill-najomne-je-velmi.why.en: Nájomné is neuter (it ends in -é, like an adjective), so vysoký takes **-é** too: nájomné je vysoké.
a2-u10-l4.fill-najomne-je-velmi.why.t: Nájomné oʻrta jinsda (sifat kabi -é bilan tugaydi), shuning uchun vysoký ham **-é** oladi: nájomné je vysoké.

a2-u10-l4.choice-prenajmem-izbu.question.en: What does the ad say about the bills?
a2-u10-l4.choice-prenajmem-izbu.question.t: Eʼlonda kommunal toʻlovlar haqida nima deyilgan?

en: They're paid on top of the rent.

a2-u10-l4.zariadeny.note.en: A **zariadený byt** has furniture: posteľ, stôl, skriňa. A **dvojizbový** byt has two rooms; a flat with one room is a **garsónka**.
a2-u10-l4.zariadeny.note.t: **zariadený byt** — mebeli bor kvartira: posteľ (karavot), stôl (stol), skriňa (shkaf). **dvojizbový** byt — ikki xonali kvartira; bir xonali kvartira — **garsónka**.

a2-u10-l4.build-hladame-zariadeny-dvojiz.en: We're looking for a furnished two-room flat.

en: Byt is masculine, so the adjective ends in **-ý**: zariadený byt. Zariadená is feminine.
“We” is my, so the verb ends in **-me**: **Hľadáme**. Hľadám is for ja.
t: Byt erkak jinsida, shuning uchun sifat **-ý** bilan tugaydi: zariadený byt. Zariadená — ayol jinsida.
«Biz» — my, shuning uchun feʼl **-me** bilan tugaydi, oʻzbekchadagi -miz kabi: **Hľadáme**. Hľadám — ja uchun.

a2-u10-l4.spolubyvajuca.note.en: You know it from the -úci words in unit 9: moja spolubývajúca, môj spolubývajúci.
a2-u10-l4.spolubyvajuca.note.t: Uni 9-boʻlimdagi -úci soʻzlaridan bilasiz: moja spolubývajúca (xonadoshim, ayol), môj spolubývajúci (xonadoshim, erkak).

a2-u10-l4.fill-lucia-je-emmina.why.en: Lucia is a woman, and after je the word stays in its basic form: **spolubývajúca**. Spolubývajúci is for a man.
a2-u10-l4.fill-lucia-je-emmina.why.t: Lusiya — ayol, je dan keyin esa soʻz asosiy shaklda qoladi: **spolubývajúca**. Spolubývajúci — erkak uchun.

a2-u10-l4.byvanie.note.en: A noun made from the verb **bývať** (to live). Verbs in -ať and -ovať give nouns in **-anie**: parkovať → **parkovanie** (parking), cestovať → **cestovanie** (travelling).
a2-u10-l4.byvanie.note.t: **bývať** (yashamoq) feʼlidan yasalgan ot. -ať va -ovať bilan tugaydigan feʼllardan **-anie** bilan tugaydigan otlar yasaladi, oʻzbekchadagi -sh kabi (yashash): parkovať → **parkovanie** (mashina qoʻyish), cestovať → **cestovanie** (sayohat).

a2-u10-l4.fill-v-bratislave-je-byvanie.e.en: Housing is very expensive in Bratislava.

a2-u10-l4.fill-v-bratislave-je-byvanie.w.en: The sentence needs a noun, the subject of je drahé: **bývanie**, made from bývať. Bývať and bývajú are verbs.
a2-u10-l4.fill-v-bratislave-je-byvanie.w.t: Gapga ot kerak — je drahé ning egasi: **bývanie**, bývať dan yasalgan. Bývať va bývajú — feʼllar.

en: Emma and Lucia are reading the ads.
Emma and Lucia are reading ads.

a2-u10-l4.speak-hladame-byt-na.en.en: We're looking for a flat to rent.

a2-u10-l5.je-byt-este.note.en: **voľný** = free, available. On the phone: Dobrý deň, volám **kvôli inzerátu**. = Hello, I'm calling about the ad.
a2-u10-l5.je-byt-este.note.t: **voľný** = boʻsh, band emas. Telefonda: Dobrý deň, volám **kvôli inzerátu**. = Assalomu alaykum, eʼlon boʻyicha qoʻngʻiroq qilyapman.

a2-u10-l5.majitelka.note.en: **majiteľka bytu** = the owner of the flat, the landlady. Like učiteľ, učiteľka.
a2-u10-l5.majitelka.note.t: **majiteľka bytu** = kvartira egasi (ayol). učiteľ, učiteľka kabi.

a2-u10-l5.choice-dobry-den-je.question.en: Emma calls the landlady about the ad. What does she say?
a2-u10-l5.choice-dobry-den-je.question.t: Emma eʼlon boʻyicha uy egasiga qoʻngʻiroq qilyapti. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l5.choice-dobry-den-je.why.en: A stranger gets **Dobrý deň**, not Ahoj. And byt is masculine, so voľný keeps its **-ý**.
a2-u10-l5.choice-dobry-den-je.why.t: Notanish odamga **Dobrý deň** deyiladi, Ahoj emas. Byt esa erkak jinsida, shuning uchun voľný **-ý** ni saqlaydi.

a2-u10-l5.build-dobry-den-volam.prompt.en: Hello, I'm calling about the ad.
a2-u10-l5.build-dobry-den-volam.prompt.t: Assalomu alaykum, eʼlon boʻyicha qoʻngʻiroq qilyapman.

en: **Kvôli** (because of, about) takes the to-whom form (dative): kvôli **inzerátu**.
Emma is the one calling, so it's ja: **volám**. Voláte is for vy.
t: **Kvôli** (sababli, …boʻyicha) datív (joʻnalish kelishigi, «kimga? nimaga?» shakli) talab qiladi: kvôli **inzerátu**.
Qoʻngʻiroq qilayotgan — Emmaning oʻzi, yaʼni ja: **volám**. Voláte — vy uchun.

a2-u10-l5.build-kolko-je-najomne.prompt.en: How much is the rent? Are the bills included?
a2-u10-l5.build-kolko-je-najomne.prompt.t: Ijara haqi qancha? Kommunal toʻlovlar narxga kiritilganmi?

en: Koľko je…? asks about the subject, so nájomné stays in its basic form.
Bills included is **v cene** (in the price): v answering “where?” takes the locative.
t: Koľko je…? gapning egasi haqida soʻraydi, shuning uchun nájomné asosiy shaklda qoladi.
«Narxga kiritilgan» — **v cene** (narxda): «qayerda?» savoliga javob beruvchi v lokál talab qiladi.

a2-u10-l5.mozeme-si-byt.en.en: Can we have a look at the flat?

a2-u10-l5.mozeme-si-byt.note.en: **pozrieť si** = to have a look at (once): pozriem si, pozrieš si… pozrú si. The si comes second: Môžeme **si** byt pozrieť?
a2-u10-l5.mozeme-si-byt.note.t: **pozrieť si** = (bir marta) koʻrib chiqmoq: pozriem si, pozrieš si… pozrú si. Si ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Môžeme **si** byt pozrieť?

a2-u10-l5.fill-mozeme-si-zajtra.en.en: Can we have a look at the flat tomorrow?

a2-u10-l5.fill-mozeme-si-zajtra.why.en: Looking at something for yourself is **pozrieť si**, with si, and si takes second place: Môžeme **si**…
a2-u10-l5.fill-mozeme-si-zajtra.why.t: Oʻzingiz uchun biror narsani koʻrib chiqish — **pozrieť si**, si bilan, si esa ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Môžeme **si**…

a2-u10-l5.choice-podte-dalej-toto.questi.en: The landlady opens the door to Emma and Lucia. What does she say?
a2-u10-l5.choice-podte-dalej-toto.questi.t: Uy egasi Emma va Lusiyaga eshikni ochdi. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l5.choice-podte-dalej-toto.why.en: She is talking to two people she doesn't know, so she uses **vy**: **Poďte** ďalej. Poď is for one friend.
a2-u10-l5.choice-podte-dalej-toto.why.t: U tanimaydigan ikki kishiga gapiryapti, shuning uchun **vy** ishlatadi: **Poďte** ďalej (kiringlar). Poď — bitta doʻst uchun.

a2-u10-l5.zmluva-a-kaucia.note.en: **podpísať zmluvu** = to sign the contract. The **kaucia** is money you pay at the start and get back when you move out.
a2-u10-l5.zmluva-a-kaucia.note.t: **podpísať zmluvu** = shartnomaga imzo qoʻymoq. **kaucia** — boshida toʻlaydigan va koʻchib ketayotganda qaytarib oladigan pulingiz.

a2-u10-l5.build-zmluvu-podpiseme-v.promp.en: We'll sign the contract on Monday.

en: The contract is what you sign, the object, so zmluva changes -a to **-u**: podpíšeme **zmluvu**.
Signing on Monday is one finished act still to come, so the perfective podpísať in its present form gives the future: **podpíšeme**. Podpisujeme is happening now.
t: Shartnoma — imzolanadigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun zmluva soʻzida -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: podpíšeme **zmluvu**.

Dushanba kuni imzolash — hali oldinda turgan bir martalik, tugallangan harakat, shuning uchun tugallangan tur podpísať ning hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi: **podpíšeme**. Podpisujeme — hozir boʻlayotgan ish.

a2-u10-l5.fill-kedy-dostaneme-kluce.en.en: When will we get the keys?

a2-u10-l5.fill-kedy-dostaneme-kluce.why.en: “We” is **my**, so the verb ends in **-me**: dostaneme. Dostanú is oni, dostanem ja.
a2-u10-l5.fill-kedy-dostaneme-kluce.why.t: «Biz» — **my**, shuning uchun feʼl **-me** bilan tugaydi: dostaneme. Dostanú — oni, dostanem — ja uchun.

a2-u10-l5.blizsie-k-univerzite.note.en: **blízko** = near, **bližšie** = nearer, closer. **k** (towards) takes the to-whom form (dative): k univerzite, k rieke.
a2-u10-l5.blizsie-k-univerzite.note.t: **blízko** = yaqin, **bližšie** = yaqinroq. **k** («…ga», «…tomon») datív (joʻnalish kelishigi) talab qiladi: k univerzite, k rieke. Oʻzbekchadagi -ga kabi, faqat soʻz oldida keladi.

a2-u10-l5.keby-bol-byt.en.en: If the flat were cheaper, we'd take it.

a2-u10-l5.keby-bol-byt.note.en: Keby, as in unit 4: the past form, and by in the other half: vzali **by sme** (we would take).
a2-u10-l5.keby-bol-byt.note.t: Keby, 4-boʻlimdagidek: oʻtgan zamon shakli, ikkinchi qismida esa by: vzali **by sme** (olardik). Oʻzbekchadagi «…ganida, …ardik» kabi.

a2-u10-l5.fill-keby-byt-nebol.en.en: If the flat weren't so expensive, we'd take it.
a2-u10-l5.fill-keby-byt-nebol.en.t: Kvartira bunchalik qimmat boʻlmaganida, uni olardik.

a2-u10-l5.fill-keby-byt-nebol.why.en: After keby, the other half is conditional too: the past form + **by**, vzali by sme. Vezmeme is a plain future: we will take.
a2-u10-l5.fill-keby-byt-nebol.why.t: Keby dan keyin ikkinchi qism ham shart maylida boʻladi: oʻtgan zamon shakli + **by**, vzali by sme (olardik). Vezmeme — oddiy kelasi zamon: olamiz.

a2-u10-l5.build-druhy-byt-je.prompt.en: The second flat is bigger, and it's closer to the university.
a2-u10-l5.build-druhy-byt-je.prompt.t: Ikkinchi kvartira kattaroq va universitetga yaqinroq.

en: Byt is masculine, so the comparative ends in **-í**: väčší. Väčšia is feminine.
t: Byt erkak jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-í** bilan tugaydi: väčší. Väčšia — ayol jinsida.

a2-u10-l5.speak-mozeme-si-byt.en.en: Can we have a look at the flat?

a2-u10-l6.mam-plne-ruky.note.en: Literally “I have hands full of work” (**plný** = full). It's Emma's busiest day at her internship; in the evening she even **zmeškala** autobus (zmeškať = to miss).
a2-u10-l6.mam-plne-ruky.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «qoʻllarim ishga toʻla» (**plný** = toʻla). Bugun Emmaning amaliyotidagi eng band kuni; kechqurun u hatto avtobusga ulgurmadi: **zmeškala** autobus (zmeškať = ulgurmay qolmoq, oʻtkazib yubormoq).

a2-u10-l6.termin.note.en: Termín je v piatok. = The deadline is on Friday: do piatku musím **pripraviť** (prepare) prezentáciu. Termín is also the date of an appointment: termín u lekára.
a2-u10-l6.termin.note.t: Termín je v piatok. = Muddat — juma kuni: do piatku musím **pripraviť** (tayyorlamoq) prezentáciu. = Jumagacha taqdimotni tayyorlashim kerak. Termín — qabul vaqti ham: termín u lekára (shifokor qabuli).

a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-si-nervozna.en.en: Emma, are you nervous? Don't worry, the presentation will be fine.
a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-si-nervozna.en.t: Emma, hayajonlanyapsanmi? Xavotir olma, taqdimot yaxshi oʻtadi.

a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-si-nervozna.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the adjective ends in **-a**: nervózn**a**. Nervózny is for a man.
a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-si-nervozna.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun sifat **-a** bilan tugaydi: nervózn**a**. Nervózny — erkak uchun.

a2-u10-l6.kolega.note.en: Masculine with -a, like turista; plural **kolegovia**, like dôchodcovia. Your boss is your **šéf**: at Emma's internship that's pán inžinier Hudák.
a2-u10-l6.kolega.note.t: -a bilan tugaydigan erkak jinsidagi soʻz, turista kabi; koʻplikda **kolegovia**, dôchodcovia kabi. Boshligʻingiz — **šéf**: Emmaning amaliyotida bu — muhandis janob Hudak.

a2-u10-l6.lezie-mi-na.note.en: Literally “he crawls on my nerves” (**liezť** = to crawl), said of someone **nepríjemný** (unpleasant). Stronger: **Leží mi v žalúdku.** = I can't stand him (literally “he lies in my stomach”).
a2-u10-l6.lezie-mi-na.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «u asablarim ustida emaklaydi» (**liezť** = emaklamoq), **nepríjemný** (yoqimsiz) odam haqida aytiladi. Kuchliroq: **Leží mi v žalúdku.** = Uni koʻrarga koʻzim yoʻq (soʻzma-soʻz «u oshqozonimda yotibdi»).

a2-u10-l6.fill-kolega-stale-telefonuje.e.en: My colleague is unpleasant, he's on the phone all the time, and he gets on my nerves.
a2-u10-l6.fill-kolega-stale-telefonuje.e.t: Hamkasbim yoqimsiz odam, doim telefonda gaplashadi va asabimga tegadi.

a2-u10-l6.fill-kolega-stale-telefonuje.w.en: The idiom takes the to-whom form: lezie **mi** na nervy, just like páči sa mi. Ma is the object form.
a2-u10-l6.fill-kolega-stale-telefonuje.w.t: Bu ibora datív («kimga?» shakli) bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagi «asabimga» kabi: lezie **mi** na nervy, páči sa mi kabi. Ma — toʻldiruvchi shakli («meni»).

a2-u10-l6.build-vecer-ma-bolia.prompt.en: My eyes hurt in the evening.

en: Oči (eyes) is plural, so the verb is **bolia**. Bolí is for one thing: bolí ma hlava.
With bolieť, the person who hurts is the object, **ma**: bolia **ma** oči.
t: Oči (koʻzlar) — koʻplik, shuning uchun feʼl **bolia**. Bolí — bitta narsa uchun: bolí ma hlava.
Bolieť bilan ogʻriq sezayotgan kishi toʻldiruvchi boʻladi, **ma** («meni»): bolia **ma** oči — soʻzma-soʻz «koʻzlar meni ogʻritadi».

a2-u10-l6.na-stole-lezi.en.en: There are a lot of papers lying on the desk.

a2-u10-l6.na-stole-lezi.note.en: **ležať** = to lie (flat), like stáť and sedieť: Papiere ležia na stole. **papier** = paper.
a2-u10-l6.na-stole-lezi.note.t: **ležať** = yotmoq, stáť va sedieť kabi; oʻzbekchadagidek, narsalar ham «yotadi»: Papiere ležia na stole. = Qogʻozlar stolda yotibdi. **papier** = qogʻoz.

a2-u10-l6.fill-papiere-lezia-na.en.en: The papers are lying on the desk, and Emma doesn't know where to start.
a2-u10-l6.fill-papiere-lezia-na.en.t: Qogʻozlar stolda yotibdi, Emma esa nimadan boshlashni bilmaydi.

a2-u10-l6.fill-papiere-lezia-na.why.en: Papiere is plural (oni), so the verb is **ležia**. After veľa it would be singular: veľa papierov leží.
a2-u10-l6.fill-papiere-lezia-na.why.t: Papiere — koʻplik (oni), shuning uchun feʼl **ležia**. Veľa bilan esa birlikda boʻlardi: veľa papierov leží.

a2-u10-l6.zapnut-vypnut.en.en: to switch on – to switch off

a2-u10-l6.zapnut-vypnut.note.en: Perfective: zapnem, zapol, zapla. You know zapnutý and vypnutý from unit 9: a phone that's on or off.
a2-u10-l6.zapnut-vypnut.note.t: Tugallangan tur: zapnem (yoqaman), zapol (yoqdi, erkak), zapla (yoqdi, ayol). zapnutý va vypnutý ni 9-boʻlimdan bilasiz: yoqilgan yoki oʻchirilgan telefon.

a2-u10-l6.fill-zajtra-pridem-skoro.en.en: Tomorrow I'll come in early and switch on the computer straight away.
a2-u10-l6.fill-zajtra-pridem-skoro.en.t: Ertaga erta kelaman va darhol kompyuterni yoqaman.

a2-u10-l6.fill-zajtra-pridem-skoro.why.en: One finished act still to come: perfective **zapnúť** in its present form means the future, zapnem. Zapínam is again and again, zapla the past.
a2-u10-l6.fill-zajtra-pridem-skoro.why.t: Hali oldinda turgan bir martalik tugallangan harakat: tugallangan tur **zapnúť** ning hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi, zapnem. Zapínam — qayta-qayta, zapla — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u10-l6.build-vypni-pocitac-a.prompt.en: Tomáš to Emma: Switch off the computer and go home!
a2-u10-l6.build-vypni-pocitac-a.prompt.t: Tomash Emmaga: Kompyuterni oʻchir va uyga ket!

en: Tomáš talks to one friend (ty), so the command has no -te: **Vypni**.
Switching off is **vypnúť**: Vypni počítač. Zapni means switch it on.
t: Tomash bitta doʻstiga gapiryapti (ty), shuning uchun buyruqda -te boʻlmaydi: **Vypni**, oʻzbekchadagi «oʻchiring» emas, «oʻchir» kabi.

a2-u10-l6.cakajte-na-linke.note.en: On the office phone. To pass a call on: **Prepojím vás.** = I'll put you through.
a2-u10-l6.cakajte-na-linke.note.t: Ishxona telefonida. Qoʻngʻiroqni boshqa kishiga ulash: **Prepojím vás.** = Sizni ulayman.

a2-u10-l6.choice-klient-vola-tomasa.ques.en: A client calls for Tomáš, and he's on another call. What does Emma say?
a2-u10-l6.choice-klient-vola-tomasa.ques.t: Bir mijoz Tomashga qoʻngʻiroq qilyapti, Tomash esa boshqa qoʻngʻiroqda. Emma nima deydi?

a2-u10-l6.choice-klient-vola-tomasa.why.en: A client is a stranger, so Emma uses **vy**, and the vy command ends in **-te**: čakaj**te**. Čakaj is for a friend.
a2-u10-l6.choice-klient-vola-tomasa.why.t: Mijoz — notanish odam, shuning uchun Emma **vy** ishlatadi, vy buyrugʻi esa **-te** bilan tugaydi, oʻzbekchadagi -ing kabi: čakaj**te**. Čakaj — doʻst uchun.

a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-pracovala-do.en.en: Emma worked until the evening and missed the bus.
a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-pracovala-do.en.t: Emma kechgacha ishladi va avtobusga ulgurmadi.

a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-pracovala-do.why.en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: zmeškala.
a2-u10-l6.fill-emma-pracovala-do.why.t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: zmeškala.

a2-u10-l6.build-do-piatku-musim-pre.prom.en: Emma: I have to prepare the presentation for Mr Hudák by Friday.
a2-u10-l6.build-do-piatku-musim-pre.prom.t: Emma: Jumagacha janob Hudak uchun taqdimot tayyorlashim kerak.

en: The presentation is what you prepare, the object, so -a changes to **-u**: pripraviť **prezentáciu**.
**Do** (by, until) takes the genitive: do **piatku**, like do kina.
t: Taqdimot — tayyorlanadigan narsa, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: pripraviť **prezentáciu**.
**Do** («…gacha») genitív talab qiladi: do **piatku**, do kina kabi.

a2-u10-l7.grammar-should-mal-by.title.en: Should: mal by som, mala by si
a2-u10-l7.grammar-should-mal-by.title.t: «…ish kerak»: mal by som, mala by si

en: You know mal by si from unit 4 and mal by som from unit 8. Here is the whole set, with ne- for shouldn't: **nemala by si**. With vy it's always mali, even for one person.
To recommend the best thing: **Najlepšie by bolo, keby**… = It would be best if…
t: mal by si ni 4-boʻlimdan, mal by som ni 8-boʻlimdan bilasiz. Mana toʻliq jadval; «…masligi kerak» uchun ne- qoʻshiladi: **nemala by si**. Vy bilan doim mali, bitta kishiga ham. Oʻzbekchada bu «…ishing kerak», «…sang yaxshi boʻlardi» degani.
Eng yaxshi yoʻlni tavsiya qilish: **Najlepšie by bolo, keby**… = Eng yaxshisi, …sa boʻlardi.

en: You shouldn't drink so much coffee.
It would be best if you went to bed.

a2-u10-l7.mam-toho-po.note.en: Emma, home at last. Literally “I've got it up to my neck” (**krk** = neck). Also: **Mám toho plné zuby.** = I'm fed up with it.
a2-u10-l7.mam-toho-po.note.t: Emma nihoyat uyda. Soʻzma-soʻz «bundan boʻynimgacha bor» (**krk** = boʻyin), oʻzbekchadagi «boʻgʻzimga keldi» kabi. Yana: **Mám toho plné zuby.** = Bundan bezor boʻldim.

a2-u10-l7.fill-tomas-mal-by.why.en: Advice takes the conditional: mal + **by** + si for ty: mal **by** si oddychovať.
a2-u10-l7.fill-tomas-mal-by.why.t: Maslahat shart maylida beriladi: mal + **by** + ty uchun si: mal **by** si oddychovať.

a2-u10-l7.fill-emma-nemala-by.en.en: Emma, you shouldn't drink coffee in the evening.

a2-u10-l7.fill-emma-nemala-by.why.en: To one friend (ty) the small word is **si**: nemala by **si**. Som is for ja, ste for vy.
a2-u10-l7.fill-emma-nemala-by.why.t: Bitta doʻstga (ty) kichik soʻz **si** boʻladi: nemala by **si**. Som — ja, ste — vy uchun.

a2-u10-l7.zobrat-si-volno.note.en: **voľno** = time off; a longer holiday is a **dovolenka**: zobrať si dovolenku. The si stays: Zoberiem si voľno. = I'll take a day off.
a2-u10-l7.zobrat-si-volno.note.t: **voľno** = dam olish vaqti, ishdan javob; uzoqroq taʼtil esa **dovolenka**: zobrať si dovolenku (taʼtil olmoq). Si tushib qolmaydi: Zoberiem si voľno. = Bir kun javob olaman.

a2-u10-l7.build-mala-by-si.prompt.en: Lucia to Emma: You should take some time off.
a2-u10-l7.build-mala-by-si.prompt.t: Lusiya Emmaga: Ishdan javob olishing kerak.

en: Lucia is talking to Emma (ty), so it's mala by **si**; the second si belongs to zobrať si. By som would be about Lucia herself.
After mala by si comes the infinitive, the -ť form: **zobrať**. Zobrala is the past form.
t: Lusiya Emmaga gapiryapti (ty), shuning uchun mala by **si**; ikkinchi si esa zobrať si ga tegishli. By som Lusiyaning oʻzi haqida boʻlardi.
Mala by si dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: **zobrať**. Zobrala — oʻtgan zamon shakli.

a2-u10-l7.chod-na-prechadzku.note.en: **prechádzka** = a walk; it **zlepší** (improves) your **nálada** (mood). And with radšej: Radšej choď spať.
a2-u10-l7.chod-na-prechadzku.note.t: **prechádzka** = sayr; u kayfiyatingizni (**nálada**) **zlepší** (yaxshilaydi). Radšej bilan esa: Radšej choď spať. = Yaxshisi, borib uxla.

a2-u10-l7.nepi-tolko-kavy.note.en: **toľko** = so much. As in unit 6, don't takes the imperfective: nepi, nerob, nehovor.
a2-u10-l7.nepi-tolko-kavy.note.t: **toľko** = shuncha, bunchalik. 6-boʻlimdagidek, «…ma» buyrugʻi tugallanmagan tur bilan keladi: nepi (ichma), nerob (qilma), nehovor (gapirma).

a2-u10-l7.fill-to-nikomu-nehovor.why.en: Nikomu (to nobody) needs a verb with ne-, and a don't-command takes the imperfective hovoriť: **nehovor**.
a2-u10-l7.fill-to-nikomu-nehovor.why.t: Nikomu (hech kimga) ne- li feʼl bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagi «hech kimga aytma» kabi, «…ma» buyrugʻi esa tugallanmagan tur hovoriť dan yasaladi: **nehovor**.

a2-u10-l7.povedz-mu-to.note.en: Lucia's advice about the colleague. **do očí** = to someone's face (oči = eyes); **mu** = (to) him.
a2-u10-l7.povedz-mu-to.note.t: Lusiyaning hamkasb haqidagi maslahati. **do očí** = birovning yuziga (oči = koʻzlar, soʻzma-soʻz «koʻzlariga»); **mu** = unga (erkak).

en: You know these from unit 6: **že** passes on a statement, **či** a yes/no question, and **aby** + the past form a request or advice: Lucia mi radí, **aby som** oddychovala. (radiť = to advise)
New here: aby also says what something is for, with the past form too: Píšem si to, **aby som** nezabudla. = I'm writing it down so that I don't forget.
t: Bularni 6-boʻlimdan bilasiz: **že** darak gapni yetkazadi (oʻzbekchadagi «…ki», «…ligini»), **či** — «ha/yoʻq» savolini («…mi»), **aby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli esa iltimos yoki maslahatni: Lucia mi radí, **aby som** oddychovala. = Lusiya menga dam olishimni maslahat beryapti. (radiť = maslahat bermoq)

Yangisi: aby biror ish nima uchun qilinishini ham bildiradi, bunda ham oʻtgan zamon shakli bilan, oʻzbekchadagi «…ish uchun» kabi: Píšem si to, **aby som** nezabudla. = Unutmaslik uchun buni yozib qoʻyyapman.

en: Lucia is asking if I'm all right.
I'm writing it down so that I don't forget.

a2-u10-l7.fill-lucia-mi-radi.en.en: Lucia advises me to go for a walk.
a2-u10-l7.fill-lucia-mi-radi.en.t: Lusiya menga sayrga chiqishni maslahat beryapti.

a2-u10-l7.fill-lucia-mi-radi.why.en: Emma is passing on advice to herself (ja), so aby takes **som**: aby som išla.
a2-u10-l7.fill-lucia-mi-radi.why.t: Emma oʻziga (ja) berilgan maslahatni yetkazyapti, shuning uchun aby **som** oladi: aby som išla.

a2-u10-l7.fill-tomas-sa-pyta.en.en: Tomáš is asking if I'm all right.

a2-u10-l7.fill-tomas-sa-pyta.why.en: A yes/no question passed on takes **či** (whether). Že passes on a statement, aby a request.
a2-u10-l7.fill-tomas-sa-pyta.why.t: Yetkazilgan «ha/yoʻq» savoli **či** («…mi») bilan keladi. Že darak gapni, aby esa iltimosni yetkazadi.

a2-u10-l7.build-lucia-chce-aby.prompt.en: Emma: Lucia wants me to go to bed.

en: Wanting someone to do something takes **aby** + the past form: chce, **aby** som išla. Že passes on a statement.
After aby comes the past form: aby som **išla**. Idem is the present.
t: Kimdir biror ish qilishini xohlash — **aby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli: chce, **aby** som išla. Že darak gapni yetkazadi.
Aby dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli keladi: aby som **išla**. Idem — hozirgi zamon.

a2-u10-l7.fill-pisem-si-to.en.en: I write the deadline down on my phone so that I don't forget.
a2-u10-l7.fill-pisem-si-to.en.t: Unutmaslik uchun muddatni telefonimga yozib qoʻyaman.

a2-u10-l7.fill-pisem-si-to.why.en: Aby for a purpose (so that) takes the past form too: aby som **nezabudla**. Nezabudnem is a plain future.
a2-u10-l7.fill-pisem-si-to.why.t: Maqsadni bildiruvchi aby («…ish uchun») ham oʻtgan zamon shakli bilan keladi: aby som **nezabudla**. Nezabudnem — oddiy kelasi zamon.

a2-u10-l7.build-emma-sa-uci.prompt.en: Emma is learning Slovak so that she can work here.
a2-u10-l7.build-emma-sa-uci.prompt.t: Emma bu yerda ishlay olishi uchun slovak tilini oʻrganyapti.

en: After aby comes the past form: aby tu **mohla** pracovať. Môže is the present.
A purpose, so that, takes **aby**. Že passes on a statement.
t: Aby dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli keladi: aby tu **mohla** pracovať. Môže — hozirgi zamon.
Maqsad («…ish uchun») **aby** bilan aytiladi. Že darak gapni yetkazadi.

en: It would be best if you took some time off.
It would be best if you took time off.
t: Eng yaxshisi, ishdan javob olsang boʻlardi.
Ishdan javob olsang, eng yaxshisi shu boʻlardi.

a2-u10-l8.znamenie.note.en: Lucia has to write the horoscope, so she asks everyone: **V akom si znamení?** = What's your star sign? — **Som Býk.** (Taurus; a býk is a bull.)
a2-u10-l8.znamenie.note.t: Lusiya goroskop yozishi kerak, shuning uchun hammadan soʻraydi: **V akom si znamení?** = Qaysi burjdasan? — **Som Býk.** (Savrman; býk — buqa.)

en: The signs are written with a capital. Most are masculine, and the people born under them take the men's plural: Baran → **Barani**, Lev → **Levi**. A final k turns into c, and -ec into -ci: Býk → **Býci**, Rak → **Raci**, Strelec → **Strelci**.
Three signs are plural already: Blíženci, Váhy and Ryby.
t: Burjlar bosh harf bilan yoziladi. Koʻpchiligi erkak jinsida, shu burjda tugʻilgan odamlar haqida gapirganda esa erkak kishilar koʻpligi keladi: Baran → **Barani**, Lev → **Levi**. Oxirdagi k — c ga, -ec esa -ci ga aylanadi: Býk → **Býci**, Rak → **Raci**, Strelec → **Strelci**.
Uchta burj allaqachon koʻplikda: Blíženci, Váhy va Ryby.

a2-u10-l8.som-byk.note.en: Býk runs from 21 April to 20 May, and Emma's birthday is on 3 May. Lucia (10 July) is a **Rak**, Tomáš (21 March) a **Baran**.
a2-u10-l8.som-byk.note.t: Býk (Savr) 21-apreldan 20-maygacha davom etadi, Emmaning tugʻilgan kuni esa 3-mayda. Lusiya (10-iyul) — **Rak** (Saraton), Tomash (21-mart) — **Baran** (Hamal).

a2-u10-l8.choice-som-baran.question.en: Tomáš was born on 21 March. What does he say?

a2-u10-l8.choice-som-baran.why.en: After som the sign stays in its basic form, for one person: Som **Baran**. Barani is the plural, Barana the object form.
a2-u10-l8.choice-som-baran.why.t: Som dan keyin burj bitta kishi uchun asosiy shaklda qoladi: Som **Baran**. Barani — koʻplik, Barana — toʻldiruvchi shakli.

a2-u10-l8.mam-stastie.note.en: **šťastie** = luck, and happiness: you know Veľa zdravia, šťastia a lásky! Bad luck is **smola**: Mám smolu. A lucky charm is a **talizman**.
a2-u10-l8.mam-stastie.note.t: **šťastie** = omad, shuningdek baxt: Veľa zdravia, šťastia a lásky! (Sogʻlik, baxt va muhabbat tilayman!) tilagini bilasiz. Omadsizlik — **smola**: Mám smolu. = Omadim kelmadi. Tumor — **talizman**.

a2-u10-l8.fill-tento-tyzden-maju.en.en: This week Taureans are lucky in love.
a2-u10-l8.fill-tento-tyzden-maju.en.t: Bu hafta Savrlarga sevgida omad kulib boqadi.

a2-u10-l8.fill-tento-tyzden-maju.why.en: Signs are people here, so they take the men's plural **-i**, and k turns into c: Býk → **Býci**, like Slovák → Slováci. Býky are bulls.
a2-u10-l8.fill-tento-tyzden-maju.why.t: Bu yerda burjlar — odamlar, shuning uchun erkaklar koʻpligi **-i** ni oladi, k esa c ga aylanadi: Býk → **Býci**, Slovák → Slováci kabi. Býky — buqalar.

a2-u10-l8.veris-horoskopom.note.en: **veriť** + the to-whom form (dative): veriť horoskop**om**, veriť ti. Or with **na** + the object form: Neverím na horoskopy.
a2-u10-l8.veris-horoskopom.note.t: **veriť** + datív (joʻnalish kelishigi, «kimga? nimaga?»), oʻzbekchadagi «goroskoplarga ishonmoq» kabi: veriť horoskop**om**, veriť ti. Yoki **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan: Neverím na horoskopy.

a2-u10-l8.fill-lucia-pise-horoskop.en.en: Lucia writes the horoscope, but she doesn't believe in horoscopes.
a2-u10-l8.fill-lucia-pise-horoskop.en.t: Lusiya goroskop yozadi, lekin goroskoplarga ishonmaydi.

a2-u10-l8.fill-lucia-pise-horoskop.why.en: Veriť without na takes the to-whom form (dative), and the plural ends in **-om**: neverí horoskop**om**. With na it would be na horoskopy.
a2-u10-l8.fill-lucia-pise-horoskop.why.t: Na boʻlmasa, veriť datív («nimaga?») talab qiladi, koʻplikda u **-om** bilan tugaydi: neverí horoskop**om**, oʻzbekchadagi «goroskoplarga» kabi. Na bilan esa na horoskopy boʻlardi.

a2-u10-l8.build-emma-veri-horoskopom.pro.en: Emma believes in horoscopes, but Lucia doesn't.
a2-u10-l8.build-emma-veri-horoskopom.pro.t: Emma goroskoplarga ishonadi, Lusiya esa yoʻq.

en: Veriť takes the to-whom form (dative), so the plural ends in **-om**: verí **horoskopom**.
Emma is ona, so the verb has no ending: **verí**. Verím is for ja.
t: Veriť datív talab qiladi (oʻzbekchadagi -ga kabi), shuning uchun koʻplik **-om** bilan tugaydi: verí **horoskopom**.
Emma — ona, shuning uchun feʼl qoʻshimchasiz keladi: **verí**. Verím — ja uchun.

a2-u10-l8.piatok-trinasteho.en.t: oʻn uchinchi sanaga toʻgʻri kelgan juma

a2-u10-l8.piatok-trinasteho.note.en: Some people think it brings bad luck. A date, as in A1: trinásteho októbra.
a2-u10-l8.piatok-trinasteho.note.t: Baʼzilar u omadsizlik keltiradi deb oʻylaydi. Sana, A1 dagidek: trinásteho októbra (13-oktabr).

en: On Friday the thirteenth Emma doesn't go anywhere.
On the thirteenth Emma is going away.
t: Oʻn uchinchi sanaga toʻgʻri kelgan jumada Emma hech qayerga bormaydi.
Oʻn uchinchi sanada Emma safarga ketyapti.

a2-u10-l8.choice-v-piatok-trinasteho.why.en: Nikam (nowhere) goes with a ne- verb: **nikam nejde** = she doesn't go anywhere.
a2-u10-l8.choice-v-piatok-trinasteho.why.t: Nikam (hech qayerga) ne- li feʼl bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagidek: **nikam nejde** = hech qayerga bormaydi.

a2-u10-l8.fill-byci-su-pracoviti.why.en: Býci are people, the men's plural, so the adjective ends in **-í**: pracovit**í**, like mladí kuchári.
a2-u10-l8.fill-byci-su-pracoviti.why.t: Býci — odamlar, erkaklar koʻpligi, shuning uchun sifat **-í** bilan tugaydi: pracovit**í**, mladí kuchári kabi.

a2-u10-l8.choice-v-akom-ste.question.en: Lucia asks pán Kováč about his star sign. What does she say?
a2-u10-l8.choice-v-akom-ste.question.t: Lusiya janob Kovachdan burjini soʻrayapti. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l8.choice-v-akom-ste.why.en: Pán Kováč gets **vy**, so the verb is **ste**: V akom ste znamení? Si is for a friend.
a2-u10-l8.choice-v-akom-ste.why.t: Janob Kovachga **vy** deyiladi, shuning uchun feʼl **ste**: V akom ste znamení? Si — doʻst uchun.

en: Leos are cheerful, but sometimes lazy.
Leos are cheerful, but they're sometimes lazy.
t: Asadlar quvnoq, lekin baʼzan dangasa boʻladi.
Asadlar quvnoq boʻladi, lekin baʼzan dangasa.
Asadlar xushchaqchaq, lekin baʼzan dangasa boʻladi.

a2-u10-l9.buduci-tyzden.note.en: You know **budúci** from units 1 and 9: budúci rok. The future itself is **budúcnosť**: Čo vás čaká v budúcnosti? = What's in store for you? (čakať = to wait, and also to lie ahead)
a2-u10-l9.buduci-tyzden.note.t: **budúci** ni 1- va 9-boʻlimlardan bilasiz: budúci rok (kelasi yil). Kelajakning oʻzi — **budúcnosť**: Čo vás čaká v budúcnosti? = Kelajakda sizni nima kutmoqda? (čakať = kutmoq, oldinda turmoq)

a2-u10-l9.dostanete-dobru-spravu.note.en: **dostať** is perfective (one finished act), so its present form dostanete points to the future. Its imperfective partner **dostávať** is for things that keep happening: Dostávate veľa e-mailov.
a2-u10-l9.dostanete-dobru-spravu.note.t: **dostať** — tugallangan tur (bir martalik, oxiriga yetgan harakat), shuning uchun uning hozirgi zamon shakli dostanete kelasi zamonni bildiradi. Uning tugallanmagan jufti **dostávať** qayta-qayta boʻladigan narsalar uchun: Dostávate veľa e-mailov. = Siz koʻp elektron xat olasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-barani-buduci-tyzden.en.en: Aries, next week you'll get some good news.
a2-u10-l9.fill-barani-buduci-tyzden.en.t: Hamallar, kelasi hafta yaxshi xabar olasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-barani-buduci-tyzden.why.en: One piece of news still to come: perfective **dostať** in its present form means the future, dostanete. Dostávate is again and again, and dostali ste the past.
a2-u10-l9.fill-barani-buduci-tyzden.why.t: Hali oldinda turgan bitta xabar: tugallangan tur **dostať** ning hozirgi zamon shakli kelasi zamonni bildiradi, dostanete. Dostávate — qayta-qayta, dostali ste esa oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u10-l9.davajte-si-pozor.note.en: **dávať si pozor na** + the object form = to watch out for something; **peniaze** = money. **Dávajte si pozor na jazyk.** = Watch your tongue. For one moment: **Daj si pozor!** = Watch out!
a2-u10-l9.davajte-si-pozor.note.t: **dávať si pozor na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli = biror narsaga ehtiyot boʻlmoq; **peniaze** = pul. **Dávajte si pozor na jazyk.** = Tilingizga ehtiyot boʻling. Bir lahzaga: **Daj si pozor!** = Ehtiyot boʻl!

a2-u10-l9.fill-raci-davajte-si.en.en: Cancerians, take care of your health.

a2-u10-l9.fill-raci-davajte-si.why.en: You watch out for something with **na** + the object form: pozor **na** zdravie.
a2-u10-l9.fill-raci-davajte-si.why.t: Biror narsaga ehtiyot boʻlish **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan aytiladi: pozor **na** zdravie (oʻzbekchada «sogʻliqqa»).

a2-u10-l9.stretnut-sa-stretavat.en.en: to meet once – to meet often
a2-u10-l9.stretnut-sa-stretavat.en.t: bir marta uchrashmoq – tez-tez uchrashib turmoq

a2-u10-l9.stretnut-sa-stretavat.note.en: One meaning, two verbs. **stretnúť sa** is perfective, one meeting: Stretnete sa so starým kamarátom. **stretávať sa** is imperfective, again and again: **Celý** (the whole) týždeň sa budete stretávať s kamarátmi.
a2-u10-l9.stretnut-sa-stretavat.note.t: Maʼno bitta, feʼl ikkita, oʻzbekchadagi «uchrashmoq – uchrashib turmoq» kabi. **stretnúť sa** — tugallangan tur, bitta uchrashuv: Stretnete sa so starým kamarátom. = Eski doʻstingiz bilan uchrashasiz. **stretávať sa** — tugallanmagan tur, qayta-qayta: **Celý** (butun) týždeň sa budete stretávať s kamarátmi. = Butun hafta doʻstlaringiz bilan uchrashib turasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-blizenci-cely-tyzden.en.en: Gemini, all week you'll be meeting up with friends.
a2-u10-l9.fill-blizenci-cely-tyzden.en.t: Javzolar, butun hafta doʻstlaringiz bilan uchrashib turasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-blizenci-cely-tyzden.why.en: All week long means again and again, so it's the imperfective **stretávať sa**, with budete. Stretnúť is one meeting and never takes budem.
a2-u10-l9.fill-blizenci-cely-tyzden.why.t: Butun hafta — qayta-qayta degani, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur **stretávať sa**, budete bilan. Stretnúť — bitta uchrashuv, u hech qachon budem bilan kelmaydi.

a2-u10-l9.fill-levi-v-piatok.en.en: Leos, on Friday you'll meet an old friend.
a2-u10-l9.fill-levi-v-piatok.en.t: Asadlar, juma kuni eski doʻstingiz bilan uchrashasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-levi-v-piatok.why.en: One meeting on Friday, still to come: the perfective present **stretnete** means the future. Stretávate is again and again, stretli the past.
a2-u10-l9.fill-levi-v-piatok.why.t: Juma kuni hali oldinda turgan bitta uchrashuv: tugallangan turning hozirgi zamon shakli **stretnete** kelasi zamonni bildiradi. Stretávate — qayta-qayta, stretli — oʻtgan zamon.

a2-u10-l9.neponahlajte-sa.note.en: **ponáhľať sa** = to hurry. And don't buy: **nekupujte**, from kupovať, as in unit 6.
a2-u10-l9.neponahlajte-sa.note.t: **ponáhľať sa** = shoshilmoq. «Sotib olmang» esa — **nekupujte**, kupovať dan, 6-boʻlimdagidek.

a2-u10-l9.build-byci-tento-tyzden.prompt.en: Taureans, don't buy expensive presents this week.
a2-u10-l9.build-byci-tento-tyzden.prompt.t: Savrlar, bu hafta qimmat sovgʻalar sotib olmang.

en: A don't-command takes the imperfective verb: kupovať → **nekupujte**. Kúpte (from kúpiť) is for buy, without ne-: Kúpte si…
Darčeky is plural (things), so the adjective ends in **-é**: drahé darčeky.
t: «…mang» buyrugʻi tugallanmagan feʼl bilan keladi: kupovať → **nekupujte**. Kúpte (kúpiť dan) ne- siz, «sotib oling» uchun: Kúpte si…
Darčeky — koʻplik (narsalar), shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: drahé darčeky.

a2-u10-l9.zit-na-vysokej.en.en: to live it up, to live in luxury

a2-u10-l9.zit-na-vysokej.note.en: Literally “to live on a high leg”: to spend a lot of money on a good life. Luxury is **luxus**.
a2-u10-l9.zit-na-vysokej.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «baland oyoqda yashamoq»: yaxshi hayot uchun koʻp pul sarflamoq. Hashamat — **luxus**.

a2-u10-l9.choice-nezite-na-vysokej.quest.en: For Taureans, Lucia writes: Nežite tento týždeň na vysokej nohe. What does she mean?
a2-u10-l9.choice-nezite-na-vysokej.quest.t: Savrlar uchun Lusiya yozadi: Nežite tento týždeň na vysokej nohe. U nima demoqchi?

en: Don't go up into the mountains this week.
Don't work too hard this week.
Don't spend too much money this week.
t: Bu hafta haddan tashqari koʻp ishlamang.
Bu hafta haddan tashqari koʻp pul sarflamang.

a2-u10-l9.sladke-reci.note.en: Literally “sweet words”. Niekto vám bude hovoriť **sladké reči**: dávajte si pozor!
a2-u10-l9.sladke-reci.note.t: Soʻzma-soʻz «shirin gaplar». Niekto vám bude hovoriť **sladké reči**: dávajte si pozor! = Kimdir sizga shirin soʻzlar aytadi: ehtiyot boʻling!

a2-u10-l9.fill-ryby-zavolajte.en.en: Pisces, call a friend who is ill.

a2-u10-l9.fill-ryby-zavolajte.why.en: Lucia writes to her readers as **vy**, and the vy command ends in **-te**: zavolaj**te**. Zavoláte is a statement: you'll call.
a2-u10-l9.fill-ryby-zavolajte.why.t: Lusiya oʻquvchilariga **vy** deb murojaat qiladi, vy buyrugʻi esa **-te** bilan tugaydi, oʻzbekchadagi «qiling» kabi: zavolaj**te**. Zavoláte — darak gap: qoʻngʻiroq qilasiz.

a2-u10-l9.fill-vahy-mali-by.why.en: Lucia's horoscope speaks to its readers as **vy**: mali by **ste**.
a2-u10-l9.fill-vahy-mali-by.why.t: Lusiyaning goroskopi oʻquvchilarga **vy** deb murojaat qiladi: mali by **ste**.

a2-u10-l9.build-kozorozci-budte-pokojni..en: Capricorns, be calm and don't rush.

en: Lucia is talking to all Capricorns, many people, so the adjective takes the men's plural **-í**: buďte **pokojní**.
Don't is **ne-**, written as one word with the verb: **neponáhľajte** sa.
t: Lusiya barcha Jadiylarga, koʻp odamga gapiryapti, shuning uchun sifat erkaklar koʻpligi **-í** ni oladi: buďte **pokojní**.
«…mang» — **ne-**, feʼlga qoʻshib yoziladi, oʻzbekchadagi -ma- kabi: **neponáhľajte** sa.

a2-u10-l10.fill-garsonka-je-mensia.en.en: A studio flat is smaller than a two-room flat.
a2-u10-l10.fill-garsonka-je-mensia.en.t: Bir xonali kvartira ikki xonali kvartiradan kichikroq.

a2-u10-l10.fill-garsonka-je-mensia.why.en: Garsónka is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: menš**ia**.
a2-u10-l10.fill-garsonka-je-mensia.why.t: Garsónka ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: menš**ia**.

a2-u10-l10.choice-audio-ste-tu.question.en: Listen. What is Lucia asking the tourist?

en: Is this your first time here?

a2-u10-l10.build-pan-kovac-mali.prompt.en: Pán Kováč, you should rest more.
a2-u10-l10.build-pan-kovac-mali.prompt.t: Janob Kovach, koʻproq dam olishingiz kerak.

en: With polite vy the past form is always **mali**, even for one man: mali by ste.
Pán Kováč gets **vy**, so it's mali by **ste**. Si is for a friend.
t: Hurmatli vy bilan oʻtgan zamon shakli doim **mali**, bitta erkakka ham: mali by ste.
Janob Kovachga **vy** deyiladi, shuning uchun mali by **ste**. Si — doʻst uchun.

a2-u10-l10.fill-majitelka-sa-pyta.en.en: The landlady is asking whether we smoke.
a2-u10-l10.fill-majitelka-sa-pyta.en.t: Uy egasi chekamizmi, yoʻqmi, deb soʻrayapti.

a2-u10-l10.fill-majitelka-sa-pyta.why.en: A yes/no question passed on takes **či** (whether): pýta sa, **či** fajčíme.
a2-u10-l10.fill-majitelka-sa-pyta.why.t: Yetkazilgan «ha/yoʻq» savoli **či** («…mi») bilan keladi: pýta sa, **či** fajčíme.

en: A walk will improve your mood.
A walk will put you in a better mood.

a2-u10-l10.fill-lucia-kazdy-tyzden.en.en: Every week Lucia gets a lot of e-mails from readers.
a2-u10-l10.fill-lucia-kazdy-tyzden.en.t: Lusiya har hafta oʻquvchilardan koʻp elektron xat oladi.

a2-u10-l10.fill-lucia-kazdy-tyzden.why.en: Every week is again and again, so it takes the imperfective **dostávať**: dostáva. Dostane is one time, still to come.
a2-u10-l10.fill-lucia-kazdy-tyzden.why.t: Har hafta — qayta-qayta degani, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur **dostávať** keladi: dostáva. Dostane — bir marta, hali oldinda.

a2-u10-l10.fill-mesto-sa-stale.why.en: **Stále** (all the time) is change that goes on, so it takes the imperfective meniť sa: stále sa **mení**. Zmení is one finished change still to come.
a2-u10-l10.fill-mesto-sa-stale.why.t: **Stále** (doim) — davom etayotgan oʻzgarish, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur meniť sa keladi: stále sa **mení**. Zmení — hali oldinda turgan bir martalik tugallangan oʻzgarish.

a2-u10-l10.choice-nekupuj-to.why.en: A don't-command is **ne-** + the imperfective verb: kupovať → **nekupuj**. Kúp to! means buy it, and nekupujem is a statement.
a2-u10-l10.choice-nekupuj-to.why.t: «…ma» buyrugʻi — **ne-** + tugallanmagan feʼl: kupovať → **nekupuj**. Kúp to! — «buni sotib ol», nekupujem esa darak gap: sotib olmayman.

a2-u10-l10.build-hladame-byt-blizsie.pro.en: We're looking for a flat closer to the university.

en: Closer is the comparative, **bližšie**; blízko is just near.
t: Yaqinroq — qiyosiy daraja, **bližšie**; blízko — shunchaki yaqin.

a2-u10-l10.fill-macka-chce-lezat.en.en: The cat is tired, it wants to lie under the table.
a2-u10-l10.fill-macka-chce-lezat.en.t: Mushuk charchagan, u stol tagida yotmoqchi.

a2-u10-l10.fill-macka-chce-lezat.why.en: After chce comes the infinitive, the -ť form: chce **ležať**. Leží and ležia are the present.
a2-u10-l10.fill-macka-chce-lezat.why.t: Chce dan keyin infinitív, yaʼni -ť shakli keladi: chce **ležať**. Leží va ležia — hozirgi zamon.

a2-u10-l10.build-doprava-v-centre.prompt.en: The traffic in the centre is worse than it used to be.

en: Doprava is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: horšia.
In the centre answers “where?”, so it takes the locative: v **centre**.
t: Doprava ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: horšia.
«Markazda» — «qayerda?» savoliga javob, shuning uchun lokál keladi: v **centre**.

a2-u10-l10.choice-radsej-chod-spat.quest.en: Emma is very tired. What does Lucia tell her?
a2-u10-l10.choice-radsej-chod-spat.quest.t: Emma juda charchagan. Lusiya unga nima deydi?

a2-u10-l10.choice-radsej-chod-spat.why.en: Lucia talks to one friend, so the command has no -te: **choď**. Choďte is for vy, and idem is a statement about herself.
a2-u10-l10.choice-radsej-chod-spat.why.t: Lusiya bitta doʻstiga gapiryapti, shuning uchun buyruqda -te boʻlmaydi: **choď**. Choďte — vy uchun, idem esa Lusiyaning oʻzi haqidagi darak gap.

a2-u10-l10.build-preco-sa-ponahlas.promp.en: Lucia to Emma: Why are you rushing? We've got time.
a2-u10-l10.build-preco-sa-ponahlas.promp.t: Lusiya Emmaga: Nega shoshyapsan? Vaqtimiz bor.

en: Lucia talks to one friend (ty), so the verb ends in **-š**: ponáhľa**š**. Ponáhľate is for vy.
To hurry is **ponáhľať sa**, with sa, and sa comes second: Prečo **sa**…
t: Lusiya bitta doʻstiga gapiryapti (ty), shuning uchun feʼl **-š** bilan tugaydi: ponáhľa**š**. Ponáhľate — vy uchun.
Shoshilmoq — **ponáhľať sa**, sa bilan, sa esa ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Prečo **sa**…

a2-u10-l10.fill-emma-hlada-byt.en.en: Emma is looking for a flat with her friend Lucia.
a2-u10-l10.fill-emma-hlada-byt.en.t: Emma dugonasi Lusiya bilan birga kvartira qidiryapti.

a2-u10-l10.fill-emma-hlada-byt.why.en: **Svoj** (her own) changes like an adjective, and s takes the instrumental: so **svojou** kamarátkou, like s dobrou kamarátkou.
a2-u10-l10.fill-emma-hlada-byt.why.t: **Svoj** (oʻzining) sifat kabi oʻzgaradi, s esa inštrumentál («bilan» kelishigi) talab qiladi: so **svojou** kamarátkou, s dobrou kamarátkou kabi.

a2-u10-l11.kariera.note.en: Lucia's reader poll asks: Čo je pre vás **dôležitejšie**: kariéra, alebo rodina? (dôležitý = important, dôležitejší = more important, najdôležitejší = the most important)
a2-u10-l11.kariera.note.t: Lusiyaning oʻquvchilar soʻrovnomasidagi savol: Čo je pre vás **dôležitejšie**: kariéra, alebo rodina? = Siz uchun nima muhimroq: martabami yoki oila? (dôležitý = muhim, dôležitejší = muhimroq, najdôležitejší = eng muhim)

a2-u10-l11.fill-lucia-sa-pyta.en.en: Lucia asks the students for their opinion.

a2-u10-l11.fill-lucia-sa-pyta.why.en: The opinion is the students', so it's **ich** (their). Svoj would mean Lucia's own, because Lucia is the one asking.
a2-u10-l11.fill-lucia-sa-pyta.why.t: Fikr talabalarniki, shuning uchun **ich** (ularning). Svoj Lusiyaning oʻz fikrini bildirardi, chunki soʻrayotgan — Lusiya.

a2-u10-l11.build-myslim-si-ze.prompt.en: I think family is more important.

en: Rodina is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: dôležitejšia.
An opinion passes on a statement, so it takes **že** (that). Či is for yes/no questions.
t: Rodina ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: dôležitejšia.
Fikr darak gap sifatida yetkaziladi, shuning uchun **že** («…ki») keladi. Či — «ha/yoʻq» savollari uchun.

a2-u10-l11.vydat-sa-ozenit.en.en: to get married (a woman – a man)

a2-u10-l11.vydat-sa-ozenit.note.en: A woman **sa vydá za** + the object form: vydala sa za Petra. A man **sa ožení s** + the instrumental: oženil sa s Janou. Their imperfective partners: **vydávať sa**, **ženiť sa**.
a2-u10-l11.vydat-sa-ozenit.note.t: Oʻzbekchadagidek, ayol va erkak uchun ikki xil feʼl. Ayol **sa vydá za** + toʻldiruvchi shakli: vydala sa za Petra (Peterga turmushga chiqdi). Erkak **sa ožení s** + inštrumentál: oženil sa s Janou (Yanaga uylandi). Tugallanmagan juftlari: **vydávať sa**, **ženiť sa**.

a2-u10-l11.fill-pani-horvathova-sa.why.en: **Vydať sa za** takes the object form, and a man adds **-a**: za **Slováka**. Slovákom would go with s, for a man's oženiť sa.
a2-u10-l11.fill-pani-horvathova-sa.why.t: **Vydať sa za** toʻldiruvchi shaklini talab qiladi, erkak esa **-a** oladi: za **Slováka**. Slovákom s bilan, erkakning oženiť sa feʼli bilan keladi.

a2-u10-l11.fill-tomasov-kolega-sa.en.en: Tomáš's colleague married an Irish woman in the summer.
a2-u10-l11.fill-tomasov-kolega-sa.en.t: Tomashning hamkasbi yozda irlandiyalik qizga uylandi.

a2-u10-l11.fill-tomasov-kolega-sa.why.en: A man **sa ožení s** + the instrumental: oženil sa s Írkou. Vydať sa (za) is for a woman, and oženila is a woman's past form.
a2-u10-l11.fill-tomasov-kolega-sa.why.t: Erkak **sa ožení s** + inštrumentál: oženil sa s Írkou. Vydať sa (za) — ayol uchun, oženila esa ayolning oʻtgan zamon shakli.

a2-u10-l11.po-tridsiatke.note.en: **tridsiatka** = (the age of) thirty: **až po tridsiatke** = not until after thirty, pred tridsiatkou = before thirty. Old age is **na staré kolená** (literally “on old knees”): Babka (grandma) sa na staré kolená naučila po anglicky.
a2-u10-l11.po-tridsiatke.note.t: **tridsiatka** = oʻttiz yosh: **až po tridsiatke** = faqat oʻttizdan keyin, pred tridsiatkou = oʻttizgacha. Qarilik — **na staré kolená** (soʻzma-soʻz «eski tizzalarda»): Babka (buvi) sa na staré kolená naučila po anglicky. = Buvim qariganda inglizchani oʻrgandi.

a2-u10-l11.materska-dovolenka.note.en: Mama je **na materskej dovolenke**. = Mum is on maternity leave. A father can take **rodičovská dovolenka** (parental leave). Dovolenka alone is a holiday.
a2-u10-l11.materska-dovolenka.note.t: Mama je **na materskej dovolenke**. = Oyim dekret taʼtilida. Ota esa **rodičovská dovolenka** (bola parvarishi taʼtili) olishi mumkin. Dovolenka ning oʻzi — taʼtil.

a2-u10-l11.choice-po-materskej-dovolenke.en: Lucia's mum went back to work after her maternity leave. Which sentence says that?
a2-u10-l11.choice-po-materskej-dovolenke.t: Lusiyaning onasi dekret taʼtilidan keyin ishga qaytdi. Qaysi gap shuni aytadi?

a2-u10-l11.choice-po-materskej-dovolenke.en: **Po** + the locative = after: po materskej dovolenke. Pred means before, and na… dovolenke is while she was on it.
a2-u10-l11.choice-po-materskej-dovolenke.t: **Po** + lokál = «…dan keyin»: po materskej dovolenke. Pred — «…dan oldin», na… dovolenke esa taʼtil davomida degani.

a2-u10-l11.dieta-tinedzer-dospely.note.en: **dospelý** works like an adjective: dospelí ľudia (adults). **Keď som bola malá…** = When I was little… (a woman speaking)
a2-u10-l11.dieta-tinedzer-dospely.note.t: **dospelý** sifat kabi oʻzgaradi: dospelí ľudia (kattalar). **Keď som bola malá…** = Kichkinaligimda… (ayol gapiryapti)

a2-u10-l11.fill-ked-som-bola.en.en: Lucia: When I was little, we lived in Žilina.

a2-u10-l11.fill-ked-som-bola.why.en: Lucia is a woman (and malá is feminine), so the past form ends in **-la**: bola.
a2-u10-l11.fill-ked-som-bola.why.t: Lusiya — ayol (malá ham ayol jinsida), shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: bola.

a2-u10-l11.travit-cas.note.en: Rád trávim čas **so svojou rodinou**. = I like spending time with my family (svoj: my own). For one stretch of time, the perfective: Víkend **strávim** doma.
a2-u10-l11.travit-cas.note.t: Rád trávim čas **so svojou rodinou**. = Oilam bilan vaqt oʻtkazishni yaxshi koʻraman (svoj: oʻzimning). Bitta muddat uchun tugallangan tur: Víkend **strávim** doma. = Dam olish kunlarini uyda oʻtkazaman.

a2-u10-l11.fill-marek-chce-vikend.en.en: Marek wants to spend the weekend with his family.
a2-u10-l11.fill-marek-chce-vikend.en.t: Marek dam olish kunlarini oilasi bilan oʻtkazmoqchi.

a2-u10-l11.fill-marek-chce-vikend.why.en: **Svoj** (his own) changes like an adjective, and s takes the instrumental: so **svojou** rodinou, like s dobrou kamarátkou.
a2-u10-l11.fill-marek-chce-vikend.why.t: **Svoj** (oʻzining) sifat kabi oʻzgaradi, s esa inštrumentál («bilan» kelishigi) talab qiladi: so **svojou** rodinou, s dobrou kamarátkou kabi.

a2-u10-l11.build-teraz-je-pre.prompt.en: Veronika: Right now my career is more important to me.
a2-u10-l11.build-teraz-je-pre.prompt.t: Veronika: Hozir men uchun martabam muhimroq.

en: Kariéra is feminine, so the comparative ends in **-ia**: dôležitejšia.
After **pre** (for), the long object form is **mňa**: pre mňa.
t: Kariéra ayol jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-ia** bilan tugaydi: dôležitejšia.
**pre** (uchun) dan keyin olmoshning uzun toʻldiruvchi shakli keladi — **mňa**: pre mňa (men uchun).

a2-u10-l11.choice-aky-je-vas.question.en: Lucia asks pani Horváthová for the poll. What does she say?
a2-u10-l11.choice-aky-je-vas.question.t: Lusiya soʻrovnoma uchun Horvatova xonimdan soʻrayapti. U nima deydi?

a2-u10-l11.choice-aky-je-vas.why.en: Lucia uses **vy** with a teacher, so the possessive is **váš**. Tvoj is for a friend, jej means hers.
a2-u10-l11.choice-aky-je-vas.why.t: Lusiya oʻqituvchiga **vy** deydi, shuning uchun egalik olmoshi **váš** (sizning). Tvoj — doʻst uchun, jej — «uning» (ayol).

a2-u10-l12.hlasovalo-dvesto-studentov.no.en: **hlasovať** = to vote. After a number from five up the verb is singular, in the past **-lo**: hlasovalo, odpovedalo. **opýtať sa** = to ask (once). One reader **vyhrá** (wins) **lístky do kina** (cinema tickets).
a2-u10-l12.hlasovalo-dvesto-studentov.no.t: **hlasovať** = ovoz bermoq. Beshdan boshlab sonlardan keyin feʼl birlikda, oʻtgan zamonda esa **-lo** bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagi «ikki yuz talaba ovoz berdi» kabi: hlasovalo, odpovedalo. **opýtať sa** = (bir marta) soʻramoq. Bitta oʻquvchi **lístky do kina** (kino chiptalari) **vyhrá** (yutib oladi).

a2-u10-l12.percento.note.en: **60 %** = šesťdesiat percent. Like eurá: jedno percento, dve percentá, päť percent.
a2-u10-l12.percento.note.t: **60 %** = šesťdesiat percent. Eurá kabi: jedno percento, dve percentá, päť percent.

en: For sixty per cent of the students, family matters most.
Sixty students think family is important.
Most students don't want a family.
t: Talabalarning oltmish foizi uchun eng muhimi — oila.
Oltmish talaba oilani muhim deb hisoblaydi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-malo-studentov-chce.en.en: Few students want to live in the dorm.

a2-u10-l12.fill-malo-studentov-chce.why.en: After **málo** comes the genitive plural, as in unit 5: for men it ends in -ov, málo **študentov**.
a2-u10-l12.fill-malo-studentov-chce.why.t: **málo** dan keyin, 5-boʻlimdagidek, koʻplikdagi genitív (qaratqich kelishigi) keladi: erkaklar uchun u -ov bilan tugaydi, málo **študentov**.

a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-studentov-chce.en.en: A lot of students want a big family.
a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-studentov-chce.en.t: Koʻp talabalar katta oila qurishni xohlaydi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-studentov-chce.why.en: After veľa the verb is singular, as if veľa študentov were one thing: veľa študentov **chce**. Chcú would be for oni.
a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-studentov-chce.why.t: Veľa dan keyin feʼl birlikda keladi, goʻyo veľa študentov bitta narsadek, oʻzbekchadagi «koʻp talaba xohlaydi» kabi: veľa študentov **chce**. Chcú oni uchun boʻlardi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-na-anketu-odpovedalo.en.en: More women than men answered the poll.
a2-u10-l12.fill-na-anketu-odpovedalo.en.t: Soʻrovnomaga erkaklardan koʻra koʻproq ayollar javob berdi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-na-anketu-odpovedalo.why.en: After **viac** comes the genitive plural. Žena drops its ending and its vowel gets longer: **žien**.
a2-u10-l12.fill-na-anketu-odpovedalo.why.t: **viac** (koʻproq) dan keyin koʻplikdagi genitív keladi. Žena qoʻshimchasini tashlaydi, unlisi esa choʻziladi: **žien**.

a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-zien-sa.en.en: These days a lot of women don't get married until after thirty.
a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-zien-sa.en.t: Hozir koʻp ayollar faqat oʻttizdan keyin turmushga chiqadi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-zien-sa.why.en: A woman **sa vydáva**; ženiť sa is for men. And after veľa the verb is singular: vydáva, not vydávajú.
a2-u10-l12.fill-vela-zien-sa.why.t: Ayol **sa vydáva** (turmushga chiqadi); ženiť sa — erkaklar uchun (uylanmoq). Veľa dan keyin esa feʼl birlikda: vydáva, vydávajú emas.

en: You know from A1 that **stať sa** (to become) takes the instrumental: stať sa lekár**om**, stať sa učiteľk**ou**. In the past: stal sa, stala sa, stalo sa.
In writing, byť can take the instrumental too, often at the start of the sentence: **Najväčším problémom** je bývanie. = The biggest problem is housing.
t: A1 dan bilasiz: **stať sa** (boʻlmoq, aylanmoq) inštrumentál («bilan» kelishigi) talab qiladi: stať sa lekár**om**, stať sa učiteľk**ou**. Oʻtgan zamonda: stal sa, stala sa, stalo sa.
Yozma nutqda byť ham inštrumentál bilan kelishi mumkin, koʻpincha gap boshida: **Najväčším problémom** je bývanie. = Eng katta muammo — uy-joy.

a2-u10-l12.fill-pre-mladych-ludi.en.en: For young people, housing has become a luxury.

a2-u10-l12.fill-pre-mladych-ludi.why.en: **Stať sa** takes the instrumental, so luxus adds **-om**: stalo sa **luxusom**. And bývanie is neuter, so it's stalo.
a2-u10-l12.fill-pre-mladych-ludi.why.t: **Stať sa** inštrumentál talab qiladi, shuning uchun luxus **-om** oladi: stalo sa **luxusom**. Bývanie esa oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun stalo.

a2-u10-l12.fill-najvacsim-problemom-je.w.en: When najväčším comes first, in the instrumental, its noun takes the instrumental too: najväčším **problémom** je…
a2-u10-l12.fill-najvacsim-problemom-je.w.t: Najväčším birinchi oʻrinda inštrumentálda kelsa, uning oti ham inštrumentálda keladi: najväčším **problémom** je…

a2-u10-l12.build-vacsina-studentov-si.pr.en: Most students think housing is expensive.
a2-u10-l12.build-vacsina-studentov-si.pr.t: Talabalarning koʻpchiligi uy-joy qimmat deb hisoblaydi.

en: Väčšina (most) is one noun, so the verb is singular: väčšina si **myslí**.
Bývanie is neuter, so the adjective ends in **-é**: bývanie je **drahé**.
t: Väčšina (koʻpchilik) — bitta ot, shuning uchun feʼl birlikda keladi, oʻzbekchadagi «koʻpchilik hisoblaydi» kabi: väčšina si **myslí**.
Bývanie oʻrta jinsda, shuning uchun sifat **-é** bilan tugaydi: bývanie je **drahé**.

en: Many Slovak words are international ones with Slovak endings. Nouns in **-ácia** are feminine (situácia, generácia), nouns in **-izmus** masculine (turizmus). Adjectives end in -ický or -álny: ekonomický, normálny.
Verbs in **-ovať** go like študovať: **preferovať** (to prefer) → preferujem, preferuješ… preferujú.
t: Koʻp slovak soʻzlari — slovakcha qoʻshimcha olgan xalqaro soʻzlar, ularning baʼzilari oʻzbekchada ham bor (turizm, normal). **-ácia** bilan tugaydigan otlar ayol jinsida (situácia, generácia), **-izmus** bilan tugaydiganlari erkak jinsida (turizmus). Sifatlar -ický yoki -álny bilan tugaydi: ekonomický, normálny.
**-ovať** bilan tugaydigan feʼllar študovať kabi tuslanadi: **preferovať** (afzal koʻrmoq) → preferujem, preferuješ… preferujú.

a2-u10-l12.fill-mladi-ludia-preferuju.en.en: Young people prefer freedom and travelling.
a2-u10-l12.fill-mladi-ludia-preferuju.en.t: Yoshlar erkinlik va sayohatni afzal koʻradi.

a2-u10-l12.fill-mladi-ludia-preferuju.wh.en: Verbs in -ovať change -ova- to **-uj-**, like študovať, and oni ends in -ú: **preferujú**.
a2-u10-l12.fill-mladi-ludia-preferuju.wh.t: -ovať bilan tugaydigan feʼllarda -ova- **-uj-** ga aylanadi, študovať kabi, oni bilan esa -ú bilan tugaydi: **preferujú**.

en: After a number from five up, the noun takes the genitive plural: dvesto **študentov**.
The poll is over, so it's the past, and asking once is perfective: **opýtali** sme sa. Pýtame sa is now.
t: Beshdan boshlab sonlardan keyin ot koʻplikdagi genitívda keladi: dvesto **študentov**.
Soʻrovnoma tugagan, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon, bir marta soʻrash esa tugallangan tur: **opýtali** sme sa. Pýtame sa — hozir.

a2-u10-l12.choice-kde-budete-o.question.en: The last question of the poll is about the future. Which one is it?
a2-u10-l12.choice-kde-budete-o.question.t: Soʻrovnomaning oxirgi savoli kelajak haqida. Qaysi biri?
