a2-u10-l12.choice-kde-budete-o.why.en: **O** + a time is “in”, from now: o dvadsať rokov = in twenty years. Pred dvadsiatimi rokmi is twenty years ago.
a2-u10-l12.choice-kde-budete-o.why.t: **O** + vaqt = «…dan keyin» (hozirdan hisoblab): o dvadsať rokov = yigirma yildan keyin. Pred dvadsiatimi rokmi — yigirma yil oldin.

en: Send us your opinion and win cinema tickets!
Send us your opinion and win tickets to the cinema!
t: Bizga fikringizni yuboring va kino chiptalarini yutib oling!
Fikringizni bizga yuboring va kino chiptalarini yutib oling!
Bizga fikringizni yuboring va kinoga chiptalar yutib oling!

a2-u10-l13.som-same-ucho.note.en: Lucia interviews Emma for the magazine. Literally “I'm all ear” (ucho = ear): Rozprávaj, som samé ucho! (rozprávať = to tell, to talk)
a2-u10-l13.som-same-ucho.note.t: Lusiya jurnal uchun Emmadan intervyu oladi. Soʻzma-soʻz «men butunlay quloqman» (ucho = quloq): Rozprávaj, som samé ucho! = Gapir, qulogʻim senda! (rozprávať = gapirib bermoq, suhbatlashmoq)

a2-u10-l13.vzdelanie.note.en: **Aké máš vzdelanie?** = What's your education? A degree certificate is a **diplom**: Mám diplom z Dublinu.
a2-u10-l13.vzdelanie.note.t: **Aké máš vzdelanie?** = Maʼlumoting qanday? Diplom — **diplom**: Mám diplom z Dublinu. = Dublinda olgan diplomim bor.

a2-u10-l13.ekonomia.note.en: You know it from unit 1: Emma študuje ekonómiu a má štipendium. Po štúdiu chce pracovať vo firme.
a2-u10-l13.ekonomia.note.t: Uni 1-boʻlimdan bilasiz: Emma študuje ekonómiu a má štipendium. = Emma iqtisodiyot boʻyicha oʻqiydi va stipendiya oladi. Po štúdiu chce pracovať vo firme. = Oʻqishdan keyin firmada ishlamoqchi.

a2-u10-l13.build-studovala-som-v.prompt.en: Emma: I studied in Dublin, and now I'm studying economics in Bratislava.
a2-u10-l13.build-studovala-som-v.prompt.t: Emma: Dublinda oʻqiganman, hozir esa Bratislavada iqtisodiyot boʻyicha oʻqiyapman.

en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: **Študovala** som.
Economics is what Emma studies, the object, so -a changes to **-u**: študujem **ekonómiu**.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: **Študovala** som.
Iqtisodiyot — Emma oʻqiyotgan fan, toʻldiruvchi, shuning uchun -a oʻrniga **-u** keladi: študujem **ekonómiu**.

a2-u10-l13.fill-pracujem-ako-stazistka.e.en: I work as an intern at a company in Bratislava.

a2-u10-l13.fill-pracujem-ako-stazistka.w.en: After **ako** (as), the job stays in its basic form: pracujem ako **stážistka**, like Tomáš pracuje ako programátor.
a2-u10-l13.fill-pracujem-ako-stazistka.w.t: **ako** («…sifatida», «…boʻlib») dan keyin kasb asosiy shaklda qoladi: pracujem ako **stážistka**, Tomáš pracuje ako programátor kabi.

a2-u10-l13.chyba-mi-rodina.note.en: You know chýbať from Christmas in unit 3: Chýbajú mi kamaráti. Sometimes Emma is nešťastná (unhappy).
a2-u10-l13.chyba-mi-rodina.note.t: Chýbať ni 3-boʻlimdagi Rojdestvo mavzusidan bilasiz: Chýbajú mi kamaráti. = Doʻstlarimni sogʻindim. Baʼzan Emma nešťastná (baxtsiz, xafa) boʻladi.

a2-u10-l13.fill-emme-chybaju-rodicia.en.en: Emma misses her parents and her brother and sister.
a2-u10-l13.fill-emme-chybaju-rodicia.en.t: Emma ota-onasini, ukasi va singlisini sogʻinadi.

a2-u10-l13.fill-emme-chybaju-rodicia.why.en: What you miss is the subject: rodičia a súrodenci are plural, so **chýbajú**. Emme (to Emma) is the one who misses them.
a2-u10-l13.fill-emme-chybaju-rodicia.why.t: Sogʻingan narsangiz — gapning egasi (soʻzma-soʻz «Emmaga ota-onasi yetishmaydi»): rodičia a súrodenci — koʻplik, shuning uchun **chýbajú**. Emme (Emmaga) — sogʻinayotgan kishi.

a2-u10-l13.lebo.note.en: You know lebo and preto from unit 4: Zostávam, **lebo** tu mám prácu. Mám tu prácu, **preto** zostávam.
a2-u10-l13.lebo.note.t: Lebo va preto ni 4-boʻlimdan bilasiz: Zostávam, **lebo** tu mám prácu. = Qolaman, chunki bu yerda ishim bor. Mám tu prácu, **preto** zostávam. = Bu yerda ishim bor, shuning uchun qolaman.

en: Emma is sometimes unhappy because she misses her family.
Sometimes Emma is unhappy because she misses her family.
t: Emma baʼzan xafa boʻladi, chunki oilasini sogʻinadi.
Baʼzan Emma xafa boʻladi, chunki oilasini sogʻinadi.
Emma baʼzan baxtsiz boʻladi, chunki oilasini sogʻinadi.

a2-u10-l13.rozhodla-som-sa.en.en: I've decided to stay. (a woman speaking)

a2-u10-l13.rozhodla-som-sa.note.en: **rozhodnúť sa** = to decide: one decision, so it's perfective. Prečo si sa rozhodla zostať? = Why did you decide to stay? — Na **ďalší rok** (for another year).
a2-u10-l13.rozhodla-som-sa.note.t: **rozhodnúť sa** = qaror qilmoq: bitta qaror, shuning uchun tugallangan tur. Prečo si sa rozhodla zostať? = Nega qolishga qaror qilding? — Na **ďalší rok** (yana bir yilga).

a2-u10-l13.choice-preco-si-sa.question.en: Lucia asks: Prečo si sa rozhodla zostať? Which answer gives a reason?
a2-u10-l13.choice-preco-si-sa.question.t: Lusiya soʻrayapti: Prečo si sa rozhodla zostať? Qaysi javobda sabab bor?

a2-u10-l13.choice-preco-si-sa.why.en: A reason starts with **lebo** or pretože (because). Preto (that's why) gives a result, not a reason.
a2-u10-l13.choice-preco-si-sa.why.t: Sabab **lebo** yoki pretože (chunki) bilan boshlanadi. Preto (shuning uchun) sababni emas, natijani bildiradi.

a2-u10-l13.fill-mam-tu-pracu.en.en: I've got a job and friends here, so I'm staying another year too.
a2-u10-l13.fill-mam-tu-pracu.en.t: Bu yerda ishim va doʻstlarim bor, shuning uchun yana bir yil qolaman.

a2-u10-l13.fill-mam-tu-pracu.why.en: **Preto** (that's why, so) brings in the result. Lebo and pretože bring in the reason: Zostanem, lebo tu mám prácu.
a2-u10-l13.fill-mam-tu-pracu.why.t: **Preto** (shuning uchun) natijani bildiradi. Lebo va pretože esa sababni: Zostanem, lebo tu mám prácu.

a2-u10-l13.fill-emma-zavolala-svojej.en.en: Emma called her mum in Dublin.

a2-u10-l13.fill-emma-zavolala-svojej.why.en: **Svoj** (her own) changes like môj, and mame is the to-whom form: **svojej** mame, like mojej mame.
a2-u10-l13.fill-emma-zavolala-svojej.why.t: **Svoj** (oʻzining) môj kabi oʻzgaradi, mame esa datív («kimga?»), oʻzbekchadagi «onasiga» kabi: **svojej** mame, mojej mame kabi.

a2-u10-l13.build-emma-sa-rozhodla.prompt.en: Emma has decided to stay in Slovakia.

en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: rozhodla sa.
Staying in Slovakia answers “where?”: **na Slovensku**, the locative.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: rozhodla sa.
Slovakiyada qolish «qayerda?» savoliga javob beradi: **na Slovensku**, lokál.

a2-u10-l13.speak-zostanem-tu-este.en.en: I'll stay here one more year.
a2-u10-l13.speak-zostanem-tu-este.en.t: Bu yerda yana bir yil qolaman.

a2-u10-spomienky.pamatas-si.note.en: The evening before Emma signs the contract, she and Lucia look at photos from her two years in Bratislava. **pamätať si** = to remember: pamätám si, nepamätám si. What you remember takes **na** + the object form: Pamätáš si na prvý deň?
a2-u10-spomienky.pamatas-si.note.t: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldingi kechqurun Emma va Lusiya uning Bratislavadagi ikki yilidan qolgan suratlarni koʻrishyapti. **pamätať si** = eslamoq, esda tutmoq: pamätám si (esimda), nepamätám si (esimda yoʻq). Esdagi narsa **na** + toʻldiruvchi shakli bilan keladi: Pamätáš si na prvý deň? = Birinchi kun esingdami?

a2-u10-spomienky.minuly-rok.note.en: **minulý** = last, past: minulý týždeň, minulá sobota. Its opposite is budúci: budúci rok.
a2-u10-spomienky.minuly-rok.note.t: **minulý** = oʻtgan: minulý týždeň (oʻtgan hafta), minulá sobota (oʻtgan shanba). Teskarisi — budúci: budúci rok (kelasi yil).

en: Do you know where we're meeting?
Do you remember how we met?

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-emma-a-lucia-boli..en: Emma and Lucia went to the castle last week.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-emma-a-lucia-boli..t: Emma va Lusiya oʻtgan hafta qalʼada boʻlishdi.

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-emma-a-lucia-boli..en: Týždeň is masculine, so minulý keeps **-ý**: minulý týždeň. Minulá goes with feminine words: minulá sobota.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-emma-a-lucia-boli..t: Týždeň erkak jinsida, shuning uchun minulý **-ý** ni saqlaydi: minulý týždeň. Minulá ayol jinsidagi soʻzlar bilan keladi: minulá sobota.

a2-u10-spomienky.na-zaciatku.note.en: **začiatok** = the beginning: na začiatku roka (at the beginning of the year). The end is **koniec**: na konci roka.
a2-u10-spomienky.na-zaciatku.note.t: **začiatok** = boshlanish: na začiatku roka (yil boshida). Oxiri — **koniec**: na konci roka (yil oxirida).

a2-u10-spomienky.ziadny.note.en: Like nikto and nič, **žiadny** goes with a ne- verb: Nemám žiadny čas. = I've got no time at all. It changes like an adjective: žiadna kamarátka, **žiadnych** kamarátov.
a2-u10-spomienky.ziadny.note.t: Nikto va nič kabi, **žiadny** ne- li feʼl bilan keladi, oʻzbekchadagi «hech qanday … yoʻq» kabi: Nemám žiadny čas. = Umuman vaqtim yoʻq. U sifat kabi oʻzgaradi: žiadna kamarátka, **žiadnych** kamarátov.

a2-u10-spomienky.build-na-zaciatku-som.p.en: Emma: When I first came here, I didn't have any friends.
a2-u10-spomienky.build-na-zaciatku-som.p.t: Emma: Bu yerga ilk bor kelganimda birorta ham doʻstim yoʻq edi.

en: Žiadny needs a verb with ne-, just like nikto and nič: **nemala** som.
Kamarátov is the men's object form, so žiadny ends like an adjective there: **žiadnych** kamarátov, like nových kamarátov.
t: Žiadny ne- li feʼl talab qiladi, nikto va nič kabi: **nemala** som.
Kamarátov — erkaklarning toʻldiruvchi shakli, shuning uchun žiadny bu yerda sifat kabi tugaydi: **žiadnych** kamarátov, nových kamarátov kabi.

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-dnes-nemam-ziadny..en: I've got no time today, my hands are full.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-dnes-nemam-ziadny..t: Bugun umuman vaqtim yoʻq, ishim boshimdan oshib yotibdi.

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-dnes-nemam-ziadny..en: Čas is masculine, so it's **žiadny**; žiadna goes with feminine words, žiadne with neuter ones.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-dnes-nemam-ziadny..t: Čas erkak jinsida, shuning uchun **žiadny**; žiadna ayol jinsidagi, žiadne oʻrta jinsdagi soʻzlar bilan keladi.

a2-u10-spomienky.opat.note.en: **opäť** and **znova** both mean again: Opäť prší. Budúci rok sa opäť stretneme na univerzite.
a2-u10-spomienky.opat.note.t: **opäť** va **znova** — ikkalasi ham «yana» degani: Opäť prší. = Yana yomgʻir yogʻyapti. Budúci rok sa opäť stretneme na univerzite. = Kelasi yil universitetda yana uchrashamiz.

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-pamatas-si-na.en.en: Do you remember our first day in the dorm?

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-pamatas-si-na.why.en: To remember is **pamätať si**, with si, and si takes second place: Pamätáš **si**…
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-pamatas-si-na.why.t: Eslamoq — **pamätať si**, si bilan, si esa ikkinchi oʻrinda turadi: Pamätáš **si**…

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-stale-byvame-v.en.en: We still live in the same room as at the beginning.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-stale-byvame-v.en.t: Hali ham boshidagidek oʻsha xonada yashaymiz.

a2-u10-spomienky.fill-stale-byvame-v.why.en: **Ten istý** (the same) changes like ten, and v answering “where?” takes the locative: v **tej istej** izbe, like v tej kancelárii.
a2-u10-spomienky.fill-stale-byvame-v.why.t: **Ten istý** (aynan oʻsha) ten kabi oʻzgaradi, «qayerda?» savoliga javob beruvchi v esa lokál talab qiladi: v **tej istej** izbe, v tej kancelárii kabi.

en: Last year in September I came to Bratislava again.
Last September I came to Bratislava again.
t: Oʻtgan yili sentabrda yana Bratislavaga keldim.
Oʻtgan yil sentabrda Bratislavaga yana keldim.

en: At first she understood nothing, but now she feels at home here.
She understands everything now, but she wants to go home.
At first she felt at home, but now she understands nothing.
t: Avvaliga u hech narsani tushunmagan, endi esa bu yerda oʻzini uyidagidek his qiladi.
Endi u hamma narsani tushunadi, lekin uyiga ketmoqchi.
Avvaliga u oʻzini uyidagidek his qilgan, endi esa hech narsani tushunmaydi.

a2-u10-spomienky.speak-tesim-sa-na.en.en: I'm looking forward to the future.

a2-u10-pisanie.listen-lucia-pise-clanok..t: Lusiya talabalar jurnali uchun maqola yozyapti.

a2-u10-l14.fill-novy-byt-je.en.en: The new flat is bigger than a room in the dorm.

a2-u10-l14.fill-novy-byt-je.why.en: Byt is masculine, so the comparative ends in **-í**: väčš**í**. Väčšia would go with izba.
a2-u10-l14.fill-novy-byt-je.why.t: Byt erkak jinsida, shuning uchun qiyosiy daraja **-í** bilan tugaydi: väčš**í**. Väčšia izba bilan kelardi.

a2-u10-l14.build-majitelka-chce-aby.prom.en: The landlady wants us to sign the contract on Monday.
a2-u10-l14.build-majitelka-chce-aby.prom.t: Uy egasi shartnomani dushanba kuni imzolashimizni xohlaydi.

en: Wanting someone to do something takes **aby** + the past form: chce, **aby** sme podpísali. Že passes on a statement.
After aby comes the past form: aby sme **podpísali**. Podpíšeme is the future.
t: Kimdir biror ish qilishini xohlash — **aby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli: chce, **aby** sme podpísali. Že darak gapni yetkazadi.
Aby dan keyin oʻtgan zamon shakli keladi: aby sme **podpísali**. Podpíšeme — kelasi zamon.

a2-u10-l14.fill-strelci-tento-tyzden.en.en: Sagittarians, this week you should rest more.
a2-u10-l14.fill-strelci-tento-tyzden.en.t: Qavslar, bu hafta koʻproq dam olishingiz kerak.

a2-u10-l14.fill-strelci-tento-tyzden.why.en: The horoscope speaks to its readers as **vy**, so: by **ste** mali. By ste can also come after mali: mali by ste.
a2-u10-l14.fill-strelci-tento-tyzden.why.t: Goroskop oʻquvchilarga **vy** deb murojaat qiladi, shuning uchun: by **ste** mali. By ste mali dan keyin ham kelishi mumkin: mali by ste.

en: Grandma learned English in her old age.
In her old age, Grandma learned English.

a2-u10-l14.build-neponahlaj-sa-mame.prom.en: Lucia to Emma: Don't rush, we've got time.

en: Lucia talks to one friend (ty), so the command has no -te: **Neponáhľaj** sa.
Don't is **ne-**, written as one word with the verb: **Neponáhľaj** sa.
t: Lusiya bitta doʻstiga gapiryapti (ty), shuning uchun buyruqda -te boʻlmaydi: **Neponáhľaj** sa.
«…ma» — **ne-**, feʼlga qoʻshib yoziladi, oʻzbekchadagi «shoshilma» kabi: **Neponáhľaj** sa.

a2-u10-l14.fill-lucia-napisala-clanok.en.en: Lucia has written an article about her town.
a2-u10-l14.fill-lucia-napisala-clanok.en.t: Lusiya oʻz shahri haqida maqola yozdi.

a2-u10-l14.fill-lucia-napisala-clanok.wh.en: **O** (about) takes the locative, and svoj ends like môj: o **svojom** meste, like v mojom byte.
a2-u10-l14.fill-lucia-napisala-clanok.wh.t: **O** (haqida) lokál talab qiladi, svoj esa môj kabi tugaydi: o **svojom** meste, v mojom byte kabi.

a2-u10-l14.fill-po-studiu-chce.en.en: After her studies, Emma wants to work in Bratislava.

a2-u10-l14.fill-po-studiu-chce.why.en: **Po** (after) takes the locative, and štúdium gets **-u**: po **štúdiu**, like po obede.
a2-u10-l14.fill-po-studiu-chce.why.t: **Po** («…dan keyin») lokál talab qiladi, štúdium esa **-u** oladi: po **štúdiu**, po obede kabi.

a2-u10-l14.choice-keby-som-mala.question.en: Which one means “If I had more money, I'd live in the centre”?
a2-u10-l14.choice-keby-som-mala.question.t: Qaysi biri «Pulim koʻproq boʻlganida, markazda yashardim» degani?

a2-u10-l14.choice-keby-som-mala.why.en: An “if” that isn't true takes **keby** + the past form, and the other half takes by: bývala **by** som. Mám viac peňazí, preto… is a fact, not an if.
a2-u10-l14.choice-keby-som-mala.why.t: Haqiqatda boʻlmagan «agar» **keby** + oʻtgan zamon shakli bilan, ikkinchi qism esa by bilan keladi: bývala **by** som (yashardim). Mám viac peňazí, preto… — fakt, «agar» emas.

a2-u10-l14.fill-mladi-ludia-dnes.en.en: These days young people don't buy flats until after thirty.
a2-u10-l14.fill-mladi-ludia-dnes.en.t: Hozir yoshlar kvartirani faqat oʻttizdan keyin sotib oladi.

a2-u10-l14.fill-mladi-ludia-dnes.why.en: Dnes (these days) is what people usually do, so it's the imperfective **kupovať**: kupujú. Kúpia is one purchase still to come, and kupuje is for one person.
a2-u10-l14.fill-mladi-ludia-dnes.why.t: Dnes (hozirgi kunda) — odamlar odatda nima qilishi, shuning uchun tugallanmagan tur **kupovať**: kupujú. Kúpia — hali oldinda turgan bitta xarid, kupuje esa bitta kishi uchun.

a2-u10-l14.speak-teraz-je-pre.en.en: Right now my career is more important to me.

a2-u10-l14.choice-emma-chce-lucii.questi.en: Emma wants to tell Lucia about her day. What does Lucia say?
a2-u10-l14.choice-emma-chce-lucii.questi.t: Emma Lusiyaga kuni haqida gapirib bermoqchi. Lusiya nima deydi?

a2-u10-l14.choice-emma-chce-lucii.why.en: **Som samé ucho** = I'm all ears, I'm listening. Plné ruky práce means being busy, and po krk being fed up.
a2-u10-l14.choice-emma-chce-lucii.why.t: **Som samé ucho** = qulogʻim senda, tinglayapman. Plné ruky práce — band boʻlish, po krk esa bezor boʻlish.

a2-u10-l14.fill-najvacsim-problemom-v.en.en: The biggest problem in the centre is parking.
a2-u10-l14.fill-najvacsim-problemom-v.en.t: Markazdagi eng katta muammo — mashina qoʻyish.

a2-u10-l14.fill-najvacsim-problemom-v.wh.en: The sentence needs a noun: **parkovanie** (parking), made from parkovať, like bývanie from bývať.
a2-u10-l14.fill-najvacsim-problemom-v.wh.t: Gapga ot kerak: **parkovanie** (mashina qoʻyish), parkovať dan yasalgan, bývanie bývať dan yasalgani kabi.

a2-u10-l14.build-zostanem-tu-este.prompt.en: Emma: I've decided to stay one more year.

en: Emma is a woman, so the past form ends in **-la**: **Rozhodla** som sa.
To decide is **rozhodnúť sa**, with sa, and it comes after som: Rozhodla som **sa**.
t: Emma — ayol, shuning uchun oʻtgan zamon shakli **-la** bilan tugaydi: **Rozhodla** som sa.
Qaror qilmoq — **rozhodnúť sa**, sa bilan, u esa som dan keyin keladi: Rozhodla som **sa**.
